    SPIDriver::SPIDriver(SPIConfig config) : SPIConfig(config) {}
    
    void SPIDriver::init()
    {
        // Initialize SPI clock
        if (clk_enable)
        {
            clk_enable();
        }
    
        // Configure CE pin as output
        GPIO_InitTypeDef GPIO_InitStruct = {};
        GPIO_InitStruct.Pin = cePin;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Mode = GPIO_MODE_OUTPUT_PP;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Pull = GPIO_NOPULL;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Speed = GPIO_SPEED_FREQ_HIGH;
        HAL_GPIO_Init(cePort, &GPIO_InitStruct);
    
        // Configure CS pin as output
        GPIO_InitStruct.Pin = csPin;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Mode = GPIO_MODE_OUTPUT_PP;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Pull = GPIO_NOPULL;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Speed = GPIO_SPEED_FREQ_HIGH;
        HAL_GPIO_Init(csPort, &GPIO_InitStruct);
    
        // Configure SPI pins (SCK, MISO, MOSI)
        GPIO_InitStruct.Pin = sckPin;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Mode = GPIO_MODE_AF_PP;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Pull = GPIO_NOPULL;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Speed = GPIO_SPEED_FREQ_VERY_HIGH;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Alternate = sckAlternate;
        HAL_GPIO_Init(sckPort, &GPIO_InitStruct);
    
        GPIO_InitStruct.Pin = misoPin;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Alternate = misoAlternate;
        HAL_GPIO_Init(misoPort, &GPIO_InitStruct);
    
        GPIO_InitStruct.Pin = mosiPin;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Alternate = mosiAlternate;
        HAL_GPIO_Init(mosiPort, &GPIO_InitStruct);
        HAL_GPIO_WritePin(csPort, csPin, GPIO_PIN_RESET);
        // Initialize SPI handle
        handle.Instance = instance;
        handle.Init.Mode = SPI_MODE_MASTER;
        handle.Init.Direction = SPI_DIRECTION_2LINES;
        handle.Init.DataSize = SPI_DATASIZE_8BIT;
        handle.Init.CLKPolarity = SPI_POLARITY_LOW;
        handle.Init.CLKPhase = SPI_PHASE_1EDGE;
        handle.Init.NSS = SPI_NSS_SOFT;
        handle.Init.BaudRatePrescaler =
            SPI_BAUDRATEPRESCALER_32;  // 180MHz / 2 = 90 MHz SPI clock (closest to 100 MHz)
        handle.Init.FirstBit = SPI_FIRSTBIT_MSB;
        handle.Init.TIMode = SPI_TIMODE_DISABLE;
        handle.Init.CRCCalculation = SPI_CRCCALCULATION_DISABLE;
        handle.Init.CRCPolynomial = 7;
    
        HAL_StatusTypeDef status = HAL_SPI_Init(&handle);
        if (status != HAL_OK)
        {
            // Error - SPI init failed
        }
    }
    
    int SPIDriver::rawWrite(uint8_t reg_addr, uint8_t *value, uint8_t len)
    {
        uint8_t buffer_tx[66];  // 1 byte address + 64 bytes data + 1 for safety
        uint8_t buffer_rx[66];
    
        buffer_tx[0] = reg_addr;
        if (reg_addr < 0x20)  // NRF24_CMD_W_REGISTER
        {
            buffer_tx[0] = 0x20 | (reg_addr & 0x1F);
        }
    
        if (value != NULL && len > 0)
        {
            memcpy(&buffer_tx[1], value, len);
        }
    
        // Select chip
        HAL_GPIO_WritePin(csPort, csPin, GPIO_PIN_RESET);
    
        // Transmit data
        HAL_SPI_TransmitReceive(&handle, buffer_tx, buffer_rx, len + 1, 100);
    
        // Deselect chip
        HAL_GPIO_WritePin(csPort, csPin, GPIO_PIN_SET);
    
        return 0;
    }
    
    int SPIDriver::rawRead(uint8_t reg_addr, uint8_t *value, uint8_t len)
    {
        uint8_t buffer_tx[2] = {reg_addr, 0xFF};  // 0xFF is NOP command
        uint8_t buffer_rx[32] = {0};
    
        if (len > 64)
        {
            return -1;
        }
    
        // Select chip
        HAL_GPIO_WritePin(csPort, csPin, GPIO_PIN_RESET);
    
        // Send register address
        HAL_SPI_TransmitReceive(&handle, buffer_tx, buffer_rx, len + 1, 100);
    
        // Deselect chip
        HAL_GPIO_WritePin(csPort, csPin, GPIO_PIN_SET);
    
        // Copy received data (skip first byte which is the NOP response)
        // memcpy(value, buffer_rx, len);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++)
        {
            value[i] = buffer_rx[i + 1];
        }
        // uint8_t *value_p = value;
        // for (uint8_t i = 0; i < len; ++i)
        // {
        //     *value_p = buffer_rx[len - i];
        //     value_p++;
        // }
    
        return 0;
    }

    // Flush the TX FIFO
    void SPIDriver::flushTx(void)
    {
        uint8_t cmd = 0xE1;  // NRF24_CMD_FLUSH_TX
        uint8_t dummy;
        HAL_GPIO_WritePin(csPort, csPin, GPIO_PIN_RESET);
        HAL_SPI_Transmit(&handle, &cmd, 1, 100);
        HAL_GPIO_WritePin(csPort, csPin, GPIO_PIN_SET);
    }
    
    // Flush the RX FIFO
    void SPIDriver::flushRx(void)
    {
        uint8_t cmd = 0xE2;  // NRF24_CMD_FLUSH_RX
        uint8_t dummy;
        HAL_GPIO_WritePin(csPort, csPin, GPIO_PIN_RESET);
        HAL_SPI_Transmit(&handle, &cmd, 1, 100);
        HAL_GPIO_WritePin(csPort, csPin, GPIO_PIN_SET);
    }

    ---
    name: embedded-developer
    description: Implement, modify, debug, review and optimize embedded firmware for STM32, ESP32, Cortex-M and related MCUs using bare-metal C/C++, FreeRTOS, Zephyr or vendor HALs. Use for peripheral drivers, GPIO, SPI/I2C/UART/CAN, DMA, ISR, boot, power, concurrency, build failures and small code changes; also low-level embedded Linux drivers/BSP implementation. Prefer embedded-architect for major design decisions and embedded-qa for independent test strategy and verification.
    ---
    
    # Embedded developer
    
    Optimize for correct, minimal, verifiable changes with low context overhead. Treat repository, board configuration and exact SDK/device documentation as authoritative.
    
    ## Implementation workflow
    
    1. **Inspect selectively:** Read affected files, project instructions, target MCU/board revision, toolchain/build, startup/linker/partition files, SDK/RTOS version and relevant tests. For new code identify missing hardware facts, do not invent them.
    2. **Match change size:** Small defects get minimal patches and focused tests. New drivers/subsystems require a short ownership/interface/error/latency contract. Ask `embedded-architect` only if OS selection, major partitioning, resource budgets or component boundaries are materially changing.
    3. **Verify hardware assumptions:** Before edits to registers, pin mux, clocks, DMA, NVIC, cache, boot, flash or low-power modes inspect exact datasheet/reference manual/errata, board design and SDK headers. Do not guess registers or APIs.
    4. **Implement narrowly:** Follow project naming, generated-code boundaries and HAL/IDF conventions. Avoid unrelated refactoring. Encapsulate hardware-specific dependencies at useful portability/test boundaries, not behind redundant layers for each GPIO.
    5. **Audit fault paths:** Bound peripheral waits by a clock valid at that boot/sleep stage, handle tick wraparound, buffer bounds, queue overflow, init ordering, cancellation, reset, power loss, and safe-state behavior. Treat `volatile` as register visibility, never a synchronization mechanism.
    6. **Verify:** Run focused unit/host tests, target build, configured formatting/static checks, and size/map/stack analysis where applicable. Delegate emulation, fault injection and on-board verification to `embedded-qa` when requested/available; distinguish NOT RUN from PASS.
    7. **Report:** Briefly state files changed, commands/results, target and hardware assumptions, unmeasured risks, and changes to public behavior/interfaces.
    
    ## Task and artifact handoff
    
    Agree an observable outcome, required inputs, integration hooks, affected checks
    and stop conditions before implementation. Missing prerequisite source blocks
    execution unless recovery/reconstruction is explicitly scoped. Registry/build
    wiring or a NOT_RUN stub does not prove the requested behavior works.
    
    Preserve source changes, all new files/configuration/licence notices and hashes
    in a durable consumer-readable bundle before workspace cleanup or completion.
    Use the runtime's supported local-file upload, verify stored readback/hash, and
    report publication failure instead of deliberating between equivalent methods
    or printing base64 into model context. After a failed bounded correction,
    preserve a done/remaining checkpoint and report the blocker; do not silently
    start another QA cycle or identical retry. Honor owner cancellation/cost-stop.
    
    ## Embedded invariants
    
    - ISRs must have bounded work, correct flag handling, approved RTOS APIs and configured IRQ priorities. Avoid blocking, heap allocation and output formatting in ISR context. Defer noncritical work, but do not invent universal ISR microsecond limits.
    - Use ownership, suitable atomics, critical sections or RTOS primitives for shared state. Check DMA/cache coherency and object lifetime; `volatile` does not prevent data races.
    - Avoid unbounded retries, queues, polling, and non-deterministic memory usage in deadline-sensitive paths. Allocations may be used elsewhere only with bounded failure behavior and a compatible project policy.
    - Feed watchdog only after verifying actual subsystem progress. Protect persistent firmware state against interrupted update or reset.
    - Preserve existing compiler and coding standard requirements. Do not claim MISRA compliance from coding style alone.
    - Never flash, mass-erase, modify eFuses, write irreversible boot/security configuration or actuate hazardous hardware without explicit authorization and a recovery strategy.
    
    ## Conditional references
    
    - STM32/Cortex-M HAL, clock, NVIC, DMA, linker: [stm32.md](references/stm32.md).
    - ESP32/ESP-IDF SMP, GPIO/strapping, IRAM, PSRAM, OTA: [esp32.md](references/esp32.md).
    - Interrupts, synchronization, DMA ownership, deadlines, tasks: [concurrency-and-realtime.md](references/concurrency-and-realtime.md).
    - Linux kernel/device-tree/BSP implementation: [embedded-linux.md](references/embedded-linux.md).
    
    For repeated board work, optionally copy [project-profile.template.md](assets/project-profile.template.md) into the firmware repo and populate it from verified sources. Keep each response short and evidence-based.

    +                       state_text(BootComponent::I2C));
    +    }
    +    else if (page == 1)
    +    {
    +        display.printf("MCU PERIPHERALS\n");
    +        display.printf("UART1 %s UART4 %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::UART1),
    +                       state_text(BootComponent::UART4));
    +        display.printf("SPI %s  ADC %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::SPI),
    +                       state_text(BootComponent::ADC));
    +        display.printf("GPIO %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::GPIO));
    +    }
    +    else
    +    {
    +        display.printf("ROBOT SUBSYSTEMS\n");
    +        display.printf("KICKER %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::KICKER));
    +        display.printf("CHASSIS %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::CHASSIS));
    +        display.printf("ODOMETER %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::ODOMETER));
    +    }
    +    display.flush();
    +}
    +}  // namespace
    +
    +void begin_boot_report(bool is_display_ready)
    +{
    +    display_ready = is_display_ready;
    +    boot_report_active = true;
    +    boot_complete = false;
    +    boot_report_started = drivers::system_clock::micros();
    +    for (BootStatus &status : boot_status)
    +    {
    +        status = {};
    +    }
    +    set_boot_status(BootComponent::OLED,
    +                    display_ready ? BootState::OK : BootState::FAILED);
    +    render_boot_page(0);
    +}
    +
    +void set_boot_status(BootComponent component, BootState state, uint8_t detail)
    +{
    +    if (component >= BootComponent::COUNT)
    +    {
    +        return;
    +    }
    +    BootStatus &status = boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(component)];
    +    status.state = state;
    +    status.detail = detail;
    +    render_boot_page(0);
    +}
    +
    +void finish_boot_report()
    +{
    +    boot_complete = true;
    +    boot_report_started = drivers::system_clock::micros();
    +    render_boot_page(0);
    +}
    +
     void screen()
     {
    +    if (!display_ready)
    +    {
    +        return;
    +    }
    +
    +    if (boot_report_active)
    +    {
    +        constexpr uint32_t report_duration_us = 15000000;
    +        constexpr uint32_t page_duration_us = 3000000;
    +        uint32_t elapsed = drivers::system_clock::micros() - boot_report_started;
    +        if (elapsed < report_duration_us)
    +        {
    +            render_boot_page(static_cast<uint8_t>((elapsed / page_duration_us) % 3));
    +            return;
    +        }
    +        boot_report_active = false;
    +    }

    struct BootStatus
    {
        BootState state = BootState::PENDING;
        uint8_t detail = 0;
    };
    
    BootStatus boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(BootComponent::COUNT)];
    bool display_ready = false;
    bool boot_report_active = false;
    bool boot_complete = false;
    uint32_t boot_report_started = 0;
    
    const char *state_text(BootComponent component)
    {
        switch (boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(component)].state)
        {
            case BootState::OK:
                return "OK";
            case BootState::READY:
                return "READY";
            case BootState::WARNING:
                return "WARN";
            case BootState::FAILED:
                return "FAIL";
            default:
                return "WAIT";
        }
    }
    
    uint8_t warning_count()
    {
        uint8_t warnings = 0;
        for (const BootStatus &status : boot_status)
        {
            if (status.state == BootState::WARNING || status.state == BootState::FAILED ||
                (boot_complete && status.state == BootState::PENDING))
            {
                warnings++;
            }
        }
        return warnings;
    }
    
    void render_boot_page(uint8_t page)
    {
        if (!display_ready)
        {
            return;
        }
    
        display.clear();
        display.setCursor(0, 0);
        display.setTextSize(1);
        if (page == 0)
        {
            display.printf("BOOT %s WARN:%u\n", boot_complete ? "DONE" : "RUNNING", warning_count());
            display.printf("DRIVES %u/4  IMU %s\n",
                           boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(BootComponent::DRIVES)].detail,
                           state_text(BootComponent::IMU));
            display.printf("OLED %s NRF %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::OLED),
                           state_text(BootComponent::RADIO));
            display.printf("CAN %s  I2C %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::CAN),
                           state_text(BootComponent::I2C));
        }
        else if (page == 1)
        {
            display.printf("MCU PERIPHERALS\n");
            display.printf("UART1 %s UART4 %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::UART1),
                           state_text(BootComponent::UART4));
            display.printf("SPI %s  ADC %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::SPI),
                           state_text(BootComponent::ADC));
            display.printf("GPIO %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::GPIO));
        }
        else
        {
            display.printf("ROBOT SUBSYSTEMS\n");
            display.printf("KICKER %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::KICKER));
            display.printf("CHASSIS %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::CHASSIS));
            display.printf("ODOMETER %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::ODOMETER));
        }
        display.flush();
    }
    }  // namespace
    
    void begin_boot_report(bool is_display_ready)
    {
        display_ready = is_display_ready;
        boot_report_active = true;
        boot_complete = false;
        boot_report_started = drivers::system_clock::micros();
        for (BootStatus &status : boot_status)
        {
            status = {};
        }
        set_boot_status(BootComponent::OLED,
                        display_ready ? BootState::OK : BootState::FAILED);
        render_boot_page(0);
    }
    
    void set_boot_status(BootComponent component, BootState state, uint8_t detail)
    {
        if (component >= BootComponent::COUNT)
        {
            return;
        }
        BootStatus &status = boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(component)];
        status.state = state;
        status.detail = detail;
        render_boot_page(0);
    }
    
    void finish_boot_report()
    {
        boot_complete = true;
        boot_report_started = drivers::system_clock::micros();
        render_boot_page(0);
    }
    
    void screen()
    {
        if (!display_ready)
        {
            return;
        }
    
        if (boot_report_active)
        {
            constexpr uint32_t report_duration_us = 15000000;
            constexpr uint32_t page_duration_us = 3000000;
            uint32_t elapsed = drivers::system_clock::micros() - boot_report_started;
            if (elapsed < report_duration_us)
            {
                render_boot_page(static_cast<uint8_t>((elapsed / page_duration_us) % 3));
                return;

    CanDriver::CanDriver(CanConfig config) : CanConfig(config) {}
    
    bool CanDriver::init()
    {
        clk_enable();
    
        GPIO_InitTypeDef GPIO_InitStruct;
    
        // TX pin configuration
        GPIO_InitStruct.Pin = txPin;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Mode = GPIO_MODE_AF_PP;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Pull = GPIO_NOPULL;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Speed = GPIO_SPEED_FREQ_HIGH;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Alternate = txAlternate;
    
        HAL_GPIO_Init(txPort, &GPIO_InitStruct);
    
        // RX pin configuration
        GPIO_InitStruct.Pin = rxPin;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Alternate = rxAlternate;
    
        HAL_GPIO_Init(rxPort, &GPIO_InitStruct);
    
        handle.Instance = instance;
    
        handle.Init.Prescaler = prescaler;
        handle.Init.Mode = mode;
        handle.Init.SyncJumpWidth = sjw;
        handle.Init.TimeSeg1 = timeSeg1;
        handle.Init.TimeSeg2 = timeSeg2;
        handle.Init.TimeTriggeredMode = timeTriggeredMode;
        handle.Init.AutoBusOff = autoBusOff;
        handle.Init.AutoWakeUp = autoWakeUp;
        handle.Init.AutoRetransmission = autoRetrans;
        handle.Init.ReceiveFifoLocked = receiveFifoLocked;
        handle.Init.TransmitFifoPriority = transmitFifoPriority;
    
        can1_driver = this;
    
        HAL_StatusTypeDef status = HAL_CAN_Init(&handle);
        if (status != HAL_OK)
        {
            uint32_t error = HAL_CAN_GetError(&handle);
            kerror("CAN init error: %d, error code: %lu\n", int(status), error);
            return false;
        }
    
        // Configure a filter to allow all messages (standard ID)
        CAN_FilterTypeDef sFilterConfig;
        sFilterConfig.FilterBank = 0;
        sFilterConfig.FilterMode = CAN_FILTERMODE_IDMASK;
        sFilterConfig.FilterScale = CAN_FILTERSCALE_32BIT;
        sFilterConfig.FilterIdHigh = 0x0000;
        sFilterConfig.FilterIdLow = 0x0000;
        sFilterConfig.FilterMaskIdHigh = 0x0000;
        sFilterConfig.FilterMaskIdLow = 0x0000;
        sFilterConfig.FilterFIFOAssignment = CAN_RX_FIFO0;
        sFilterConfig.FilterActivation = ENABLE;
        sFilterConfig.SlaveStartFilterBank = 14;
    
        status = HAL_CAN_ConfigFilter(&handle, &sFilterConfig);
        if (status != HAL_OK)
        {
            uint32_t error = HAL_CAN_GetError(&handle);
            kerror("CAN filter config error: %d, error code: %lu\n", int(status), error);
            return false;
        }
    
        status = HAL_CAN_Start(&handle);
        if (status != HAL_OK)
        {
            uint32_t error = HAL_CAN_GetError(&handle);
            kerror("CAN start error: %d, error code: %lu\n", int(status), error);
            return false;
        }
    
        HAL_NVIC_SetPriority(CAN1_RX0_IRQn, 5, 0);
        HAL_NVIC_EnableIRQ(CAN1_RX0_IRQn);
    
        status = HAL_CAN_ActivateNotification(&handle,
                                              CAN_IT_RX_FIFO0_MSG_PENDING | CAN_IT_RX_FIFO0_OVERRUN);
        if (status != HAL_OK)
        {
            uint32_t error = HAL_CAN_GetError(&handle);
            kerror("CAN RX notification error: %d, error code: %lu\n", int(status), error);
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool UartDriver::init()
    {
        clk_enable();
    
        GPIO_InitTypeDef GPIO_InitStruct;
    
        GPIO_InitStruct.Pin = txPin;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Mode = GPIO_MODE_AF_PP;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Pull = GPIO_PULLUP;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Speed = GPIO_SPEED_FAST;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Alternate = txAlternate;
    
        HAL_GPIO_Init(txPort, &GPIO_InitStruct);
    
        GPIO_InitStruct.Pin = rxPin;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Alternate = rxAlternate;
    
        HAL_GPIO_Init(rxPort, &GPIO_InitStruct);
    
        handle.Instance = instance;
    
        handle.Init.BaudRate = baudrate;
        handle.Init.WordLength = wordLength;
        handle.Init.StopBits = stopBits;
        handle.Init.Parity = parity;
        handle.Init.HwFlowCtl = hwFlowControl;
        handle.Init.Mode = mode;
        handle.Init.OverSampling = overSampling;
    
        msp_init_ok_ = true;
        HAL_StatusTypeDef status = HAL_UART_Init(&handle);
        if (status != HAL_OK || !msp_init_ok_)
        {
            kerror("UART init failed: status=%d", static_cast<int>(status));
            return false;
        }
    
        rx_dma_tail_ = 0;
        status = HAL_UART_Receive_DMA(&handle, rx_dma_buf_, kRxDmaBufSize);
        if (status != HAL_OK)
        {
            kerror("UART RX DMA start failed: status=%d", static_cast<int>(status));
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    void UartDriver::dma_rx_irq()
    {
        HAL_DMA_IRQHandler(&hdma_rx_);
        [CHECKER_DEEP] = {GPIOF, GPIO_PIN_10},
        [CHECKER_FRONT] = {GPIOF, GPIO_PIN_7},
        [BUTTON_TURN_OFF] = {GPIOC, GPIO_PIN_11},
    };
    
    gpio::GPIODescriptor analog_pins_desc[] = {
        [KICKER_VOLTAGE] = {GPIOC, GPIO_PIN_1},
    };
    
    gpio::ADCDescriptor adc_desc[] = {
        [KICKER_VOLTAGE] = {ADC1, ADC_RESOLUTION_12B, ADC_DATAALIGN_RIGHT, DISABLE, ENABLE, ADC_SOFTWARE_START, ADC_EXTERNALTRIGCONVEDGE_NONE, ADC_CHANNEL_11},
    };
    
    gpio::GPIOAnalogInputDriver analog_in_pin;
    
    InitStatus init()
    {
        InitStatus status{};
        drivers::system_clock_drv.init();
        drivers::bootstrap_drv.init();
    
        // HAL_Delay(5000);
    
        status.uart4 = drivers::uart4.init();
        status.uart1 = drivers::uart1.init();
        status.i2c = drivers::i2c2.init();
        __HAL_RCC_ADC1_CLK_ENABLE();
        __HAL_RCC_GPIOC_CLK_ENABLE();
        __HAL_RCC_GPIOG_CLK_ENABLE();
        __HAL_RCC_GPIOD_CLK_ENABLE();
        __HAL_RCC_GPIOE_CLK_ENABLE();
    
        static uint32_t adcBuffer[1] = {0};
    
        for (int i = 0; i < OUT_COUNT; i++)
        {
            out_pins[i].init(out_pins_desc[i]);
            if ((i==CHARGE) || (i == DISCHARGE) || (i==STRAIGHT) || (i==CHIP))
            {
                out_pins[i].write(true);
            }
            if ((i==DEEP_LED) || (i==FRONT_LED))
            {
                out_pins[i].write(true);
            }
    
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < INPUT_COUNT; i++)
        {
            in_pins[i].init(in_pins_desc[i]);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 1; i++)
        {
            status.adc = analog_in_pin.init(analog_pins_desc[i], adc_desc[i], adcBuffer, 1);
        }
    
        status.can = drivers::can_drv.init();
        status.spi = drivers::spi2.init();
        return status;
    }

    #include "shell.hpp"
    
    #include "drivers/driver_manager.hpp"
    #include "kernel/kernel.hpp"
    
    namespace devices::shell
    {
    
    Shell shell;
    
    signed short shellWrite(char *data, unsigned short len)
    {
        for (unsigned short i = 0; i < len; i++)
        {
            kernel::scheduler::yield();
            drivers::uart4.putc(data[i]);
        }
        drivers::uart4.flush_tx();
        return len;
    }
    
    signed short shellRead(char *data, unsigned short len)
    {
        unsigned short recv = len;
        for (unsigned short i = 0; i < len; i++)
        {
            kernel::scheduler::yield();
            if (drivers::uart4.getc(&data[i]) != HAL_OK)
            {
                recv = i;
                break;
            }
        }
        return recv;
    }
    
    char shellBuffer[512];
    
    void my_shellInit()
    {
        shell.read = shellRead;
        shell.write = shellWrite;
        shellInit(&shell, shellBuffer, 512);
    }
    
    void my_shellLoop()
    {
        shellTask(&shell);
    }
    
    }  // namespace devices::shell
    
    int func(int argc, char *argv[])
    {
        drivers::uart4.printf("%dparameter(s)\r\n", argc);
        for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++)
        {
            drivers::uart4.printf("%s\r\n", argv[i]);
        }
    
        return 0;
    }

        bool readmulreg(char reg_addr, char *buff, size_t buff_size)
        {
            if (buff == nullptr || buff_size == 0 || buff_size > 126)
            {
                return false;
            }
            tx[0] = 0xAA;  // Start byte
            tx[1] = 0x01;  // Read
            tx[2] = reg_addr;
            tx[3] = buff_size;
            uart_drv.write(tx, 4);
    
            char rx_buff[128] = {};
            HAL_StatusTypeDef status = uart_drv.read(rx_buff, buff_size + 2, 10000U);
    
            if (status != HAL_OK || static_cast<uint8_t>(rx_buff[0]) != 0xBB ||
                static_cast<uint8_t>(rx_buff[1]) != buff_size)
            {
                kerror("BNO055 UART block read failed: reg=0x%02X len=%u status=%d header=%02X %02X",
                       static_cast<uint8_t>(reg_addr), static_cast<unsigned>(buff_size),
                       static_cast<int>(status), static_cast<uint8_t>(rx_buff[0]),
                       static_cast<uint8_t>(rx_buff[1]));
                return false;
            }
    
            for (size_t i = 0; i < buff_size; i++)
            {
                buff[i] = rx_buff[i + 2];
            }
            return true;
        }
    
        bool writecharreg(char reg_addr, char value)
        {
            tx[0] = 0xAA;  // Start byte
            tx[1] = 0x00;  // Write
            tx[2] = reg_addr;
            tx[3] = 1;  // Length
            tx[4] = value;
            uart_drv.write(tx, 5);
    
            char rx_buff[2] = {};
            HAL_StatusTypeDef status = uart_drv.read(rx_buff, sizeof(rx_buff), 10000U);
            if (status != HAL_OK || static_cast<uint8_t>(rx_buff[0]) != 0xEE ||
                static_cast<uint8_t>(rx_buff[1]) != 0x01)
            {
                kerror("BNO055 UART write failed: reg=0x%02X status=%d ack=%02X %02X",
                       static_cast<uint8_t>(reg_addr), static_cast<int>(status),
                       static_cast<uint8_t>(rx_buff[0]), static_cast<uint8_t>(rx_buff[1]));
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
    
        void writemulreg(char reg_addr, char *buff, size_t buff_size)
        {
            tx[0] = 0xAA;  // Start byte
            tx[1] = 0x00;  // Write
            tx[2] = reg_addr;
            tx[3] = buff_size;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < buff_size; i++)
            {
                tx[i + 4] = buff[i];
            }
            uart_drv.write(tx, buff_size + 4);
    
            char rx_buff[2] = {};
            HAL_StatusTypeDef status = uart_drv.read(rx_buff, sizeof(rx_buff), 10000U);
            if (status != HAL_OK || static_cast<uint8_t>(rx_buff[0]) != 0xEE ||
                static_cast<uint8_t>(rx_buff[1]) != 0x01)
            {
                kerror("BNO055 UART block write failed: reg=0x%02X status=%d ack=%02X %02X",
                       static_cast<uint8_t>(reg_addr), static_cast<int>(status),
                       static_cast<uint8_t>(rx_buff[0]), static_cast<uint8_t>(rx_buff[1]));
                return;
            }
        }
    
        bool setpage(char value)
        {
            return writecharreg(BNO055_PAGE_ID_ADDR, value);
        }

    BNO055::BNO055(BNO055Config &config) : BNO055Config(config)
    {
        address = BNOAddress;
        accel_scale = 0.001f;
        rate_scale = 1.0f / 16.0f;
        angle_scale = 1.0f / 16.0f;
        temp_scale = 1;
    }
    
    bool BNO055::reset()
    {
        online = false;
        if (!readcharreg(BNO055_SYS_TRIGGER_ADDR))
        {
            return false;
        }
        rx = static_cast<char>(static_cast<uint8_t>(rx) | 0x20U);
        if (!writecharreg(BNO055_SYS_TRIGGER_ADDR, rx))
        {
            return false;
        }
        // Wait for the system to come back up again (datasheet says 650ms)
        // wait_ms(675);
        kernel::delay_ms(675);
        return true;
    }
    
    bool BNO055::check()
    {
        online = false;
        // Check we have communication link with the chip
        if (!readcharreg(BNO055_CHIP_ID_ADDR) || static_cast<uint8_t>(rx) != 0xA0)
            return false;
        // Grab the chip ID and software versions
        tx[0] = BNO055_CHIP_ID_ADDR;
        // _i2c.write(address, tx, 1, true);
        // _i2c.read(address + 1, rawdata, 7, false);
        if (!readmulreg(BNO055_CHIP_ID_ADDR, rawdata, 7))
        {
            return false;
        }
        // writemulreg(address, tx, 1);
        // readmulreg(address + 1, rawdata, 7);
        ID.id = rawdata[0];
        ID.accel = rawdata[1];
        ID.mag = rawdata[2];
        ID.gyro = rawdata[3];
        ID.sw[0] = rawdata[4];
        ID.sw[1] = rawdata[5];
        ID.bootload = rawdata[6];
        if (!setpage(1))
        {
            return false;
        }
        tx[0] = BNO055_UNIQUE_ID_ADDR;
        // _i2c.write(address, tx, 1, true);
        // _i2c.read(address + 1, ID.serial, 16, false);
        // writemulreg(address, tx, 1);
        // readmulreg(address + 1, ID.serial, 16);
        bool serial_read = readmulreg(BNO055_UNIQUE_ID_ADDR, ID.serial, 16);
        bool page_restored = setpage(0);
        online = serial_read && page_restored;
        return online;
    }
    
    void BNO055::SetExternalCrystal(bool yn)
    {
        // Read the current status from the device
        if (!readcharreg(BNO055_SYS_TRIGGER_ADDR))
        {
            return;
        }
        if (yn)
            rx = rx | 0x80;
        else
            rx = rx & 0x7F;
        writecharreg(BNO055_SYS_TRIGGER_ADDR, rx);
    }

    bool BldcsDriver::motorWrite(uint8_t motor_addr, uint8_t register_addr, const uint8_t *data,
                                 uint8_t len)
    {
        uint32_t id = (static_cast<uint32_t>(motor_addr & 0x0F) << 7) | (register_addr & 0x7F);
        return can->write(id, data, len);
    }
    
    void BldcsDriver::setDriveRegisterFloat(uint8_t register_addr, float value)
    {
        motorWrite(0, register_addr, reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(&value), 4);
    }
    
    void BldcsDriver::setDriveVel(BldcsVec vel)
    {
        uint8_t payload[8] = {0};
    
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 4; i++)
        {
            float value = -vel.vec[i];  // Positive speed should be CCW viewed from the top
            ushort value_fp16 = fp32_to_fp16(value);
            reinterpret_cast<uint16_t *>(payload)[i] = value_fp16;
        }
    
        motorWrite(0, MULTI_TARGET_W, payload, 8);
    
        kdebug("setDriveVel: %f %f %f %f", vel.vec[0], vel.vec[1], vel.vec[2], vel.vec[3]);
        target_vel = vel;
    }
    
    void BldcsDriver::pollFeedback()
    {
        uint32_t response_id;
        uint8_t response[8];
        uint8_t response_len;
    
        for (uint8_t frames_read = 0;
             frames_read < 8 && can->read(&response_id, response, &response_len); frames_read++)
        {
            uint8_t motor_addr = (response_id >> 7) & 0x0F;
            uint8_t register_addr = response_id & 0x7F;
            if (motor_addr < 1 || motor_addr > 4)
            {
                continue;
            }
    
            const uint8_t offset = motor_addr - 1;
            if (register_addr == SUPPLY_VOLTAGE_R && response_len == sizeof(float))
            {
                float voltage;
                std::memcpy(&voltage, response, sizeof(voltage));
                can_battery_voltage = voltage;
                can_drive_voltage[offset] = voltage;
                received_feedback_mask |= 1U << offset;
            }
            else if (register_addr == SHAFT_FEEDBACK_R && response_len == 2 * sizeof(float))
            {
                std::memcpy(&current_vel.vec[offset], &response[0], sizeof(float));
                std::memcpy(&current_pos.vec[offset], &response[4], sizeof(float));
                can_drive_velocity[offset] = current_vel.vec[offset];
                can_drive_position[offset] = current_pos.vec[offset];
                received_feedback_mask |= 1U << offset;
                position_feedback_mask |= 1U << offset;
            }
            else if ((register_addr == PCB_TEMPERATURE_R || register_addr == MOTOR_TEMPERATURE_R) &&
                     response_len == sizeof(float))
            {
                float temperature;
                std::memcpy(&temperature, response, sizeof(temperature));
                if (register_addr == PCB_TEMPERATURE_R)
                {

        }

    bool CanDriver::write(uint32_t id, const uint8_t *data, uint8_t len)
    {
        if (!initialized_ || data == nullptr || len > 8 || id > 0x7FF)
        {
            return false;
        }
    
        CAN_TxHeaderTypeDef TxHeader;
        uint8_t TxData[8];
        uint32_t TxMailbox;
    
        TxHeader.StdId = id;
        TxHeader.ExtId = 0;
        TxHeader.RTR = CAN_RTR_DATA;
        TxHeader.IDE = CAN_ID_STD;
        TxHeader.DLC = len;
        TxHeader.TransmitGlobalTime = DISABLE;
    
        for (uint8_t i = 0; i < len; i++)
        {
            TxData[i] = data[i];
        }
    
        // Try to add message to available mailbox
        uint32_t timeout = 10000;
        HAL_StatusTypeDef status = HAL_BUSY;
    
        while (status == HAL_BUSY && timeout-- > 0)
        {
            status = HAL_CAN_AddTxMessage(&handle, &TxHeader, TxData, &TxMailbox);
            HAL_Delay(1);
        }
    
        if (status != HAL_OK)
    {
        drivers::uart1.dma_tx_irq();
    }

        }
        else if (instance == USART1)

            HAL_NVIC_EnableIRQ(USART1_IRQn);
        }
    
        hdma_rx_.Instance = dma_rx_stream;
        hdma_rx_.Init.Channel = dma_rx_channel;
        hdma_rx_.Init.Direction = DMA_PERIPH_TO_MEMORY;
        hdma_rx_.Init.PeriphInc = DMA_PINC_DISABLE;
        hdma_rx_.Init.MemInc = DMA_MINC_ENABLE;
        hdma_rx_.Init.PeriphDataAlignment = DMA_PDATAALIGN_BYTE;
        hdma_rx_.Init.MemDataAlignment = DMA_MDATAALIGN_BYTE;
        hdma_rx_.Init.Mode = DMA_CIRCULAR;
        hdma_rx_.Init.Priority = DMA_PRIORITY_HIGH;
        hdma_rx_.Init.FIFOMode = DMA_FIFOMODE_DISABLE;
    
        hdma_tx_.Instance = dma_tx_stream;
        hdma_tx_.Init.Channel = dma_tx_channel;
        hdma_tx_.Init.Direction = DMA_MEMORY_TO_PERIPH;
        hdma_tx_.Init.PeriphInc = DMA_PINC_DISABLE;
        hdma_tx_.Init.MemInc = DMA_MINC_ENABLE;

        hdma_tx_.Init.Mode = DMA_NORMAL;
        hdma_tx_.Init.Priority = DMA_PRIORITY_MEDIUM;
        hdma_tx_.Init.FIFOMode = DMA_FIFOMODE_DISABLE;
    
        __HAL_LINKDMA(&handle, hdmarx, hdma_rx_);
        __HAL_LINKDMA(&handle, hdmatx, hdma_tx_);
    
        if (HAL_DMA_Init(&hdma_rx_) != HAL_OK || HAL_DMA_Init(&hdma_tx_) != HAL_OK)
        {
            msp_init_ok_ = false;
            kerror("UART DMA initialization failed");
            return;

        HAL_NVIC_SetPriority(dma_rx_irqn, 6, 0);
        HAL_NVIC_EnableIRQ(dma_rx_irqn);
        HAL_NVIC_SetPriority(dma_tx_irqn, 6, 0);
        HAL_NVIC_EnableIRQ(dma_tx_irqn);
    }

## Assistant

По одному `IMU FAIL` и `DRIVES FAIL` причину не определить. Экран различает сбой MCU-драйвера и отсутствие ответа устройства:

- **`UART1 FAIL`** — не запустились USART1 или его DMA; IMU даже не опрашивается. UART1 настроен на PA9/PA10, 115200 8N1.
- **`UART1 OK`, `IMU FAIL`** — MCU поднял UART, но BNO055 не ответил ожидаемым протоколом. Проверьте питание, общий GND, TX/RX и выбор интерфейса: у BNO055 UART требует PS1:PS0 = `1:0`, выводы не должны плавать; скорость 115200 8N1. [Datasheet Bosch](https://www.bosch-sensortec.com/media/boschsensortec/downloads/datasheets/bst-bno055-ds000.pdf)
- **`CAN FAIL`** — ошибка HAL при старте CAN или RX-уведомлений.
- **`CAN OK`, `DRIVES 0/4`** — CAN-периферия MCU запущена, но прошивка не распознала энкодерную телеметрию. Проверьте питание приводов, трансивер, CAN-H/L, терминаторы, скорость шины (в коде 1 Мбит/с) и адреса приводов 1–4.
- **`DRIVES N/4`** — телеметрию получили только `N` приводов. Это указывает на конкретный привод, его адрес или соединение.

Важно: экран проверяет не отдельный сигнал «привод готов», а ответы CAN-регистра `SHAFT_FEEDBACK_R`. Проверка длится около 400 мс после одной команды настройки мониторинга, поэтому медленный старт приводов может дать ложное `0/4`; статус после этого сам не обновляется.

Для точного диагноза нужны значения **CAN, UART1 и DRIVES N/4** со страниц экрана и строки лога `BNO055 UART ...` или `CAN ...`. На плате проверку не выполнял.

    # ultracave
    
    Respond terse like smart caveman. All technical substance stay. Only fluff die. Then cut again.
    
    Ultracave is caveman with the grammar stripped. Payload only.
    
    ## Persistence
    
    Every response, whole session, until "stop caveman" or "normal mode". Unsure? Still on. `/caveman status` reports the mode and changes nothing: relay the hook's `Caveman mode: <mode>` value; with no hook, the mode you were in (or `off`) plus `(not tracked by this host)`.
    
    ## Floor
    
    Never cut: code, commands, paths, API names, error strings (verbatim). not/never/no/only/except. Numbers and units. The user's language. One term per thing. No invented abbreviations, no arrows. Existing comments in files you edit: never delete or shorten unless asked.
    
    ## Rules
    
    ### 1. Fragments
    
    Drop articles, copulas, connectives when order stays clear.
    
    Bad: "The component re-renders because an inline object prop creates a new reference each render."
    Good: "Inline object prop, new ref, re-render. `useMemo`."
    
    ### 2. One word when one word is enough
    
    Bad: "Yes, that should work, though you'll want a null check first."
    Good: "Yes. Null check first."
    
    ### 3. Each fact once
    
    No restating, no summary after a list. Code change: changed lines plus context, not the whole file.
    
    Good: "Pool reuses open DB connections. No per-request handshake."
    
    ### 4. Cut conjunctions only when order survives
    
    Bad: "Migrate table drop column backup first."
    Good: "Back up first. Then migrate: drops column."
    
    ### 5. Tool runs
    
    One line in, one line out. Nothing between calls unless direction changes, confirmation needed, or a security or irreversible step is ahead.
    
    ### 6. Never perform
    
    No prefix, no announcement, no mangled verbs for flavor. Fragment not shorter than the sentence? Use the sentence.
    
    ## When to break the rules
    
    Plain prose, then resume: security warning. Irreversible action, confirm first. Any fragment with two readings. User confused. Question to the user, with its options. Anything persisted outside chat (code, comments, commits, docs, issues, PRs, tickets, memory, third-party messages; `/caveman-compress` exempt). Harness asks for a status line.

    #pragma once
    
    #include <stdint.h>
    
    namespace apps::screen
    {
    
    /** Hardware or subsystem reported on the boot screen. */
    enum class BootComponent : uint8_t
    {
        OLED,
        CAN,
        IMU_UART,
        LOG_UART,
        I2C,
        SPI,
        ANALOG_INPUT,
        RADIO,
        IMU,
        DRIVES,
        KICKER,
        CHASSIS,
        ODOMETER,
        GPIO,
        COUNT,
    };
    
    /** Result reported for one boot component. */
    enum class BootState : uint8_t
    {
        PENDING,
        OK,
        READY,
        WARNING,
        FAILED,
    };
    
    /** Starts boot reporting and records whether the OLED is available. */
    void begin_boot_report(bool display_ready);
    /** Updates one component and refreshes the current boot page. */
    void set_boot_status(BootComponent component, BootState state, uint8_t detail = 0);
    /** Completes the report and keeps it visible while pages rotate. */
    void finish_boot_report();
    void screen();
    
    }  // namespace apps::screen

    namespace apps::screen

    namespace
    {
    struct BootStatus
    {
        BootState state = BootState::PENDING;
        uint8_t detail = 0;
    };
    
    BootStatus boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(BootComponent::COUNT)];
    bool display_ready = false;
    bool boot_report_active = false;
    bool boot_complete = false;
    uint32_t boot_report_started = 0;
    
    const char *state_text(BootComponent component)
    {
        switch (boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(component)].state)
        {
            case BootState::OK:
                return "OK";
            case BootState::READY:
                return "READY";
            case BootState::WARNING:
                return "WARN";
            case BootState::FAILED:
                return "FAIL";
            default:
                return "WAIT";
        }
    }
    
    uint8_t warning_count()
    {
        uint8_t warnings = 0;
        for (const BootStatus &status : boot_status)
        {
            if (status.state == BootState::WARNING || status.state == BootState::FAILED ||
                (boot_complete && status.state == BootState::PENDING))
            {
                warnings++;
            }
        }
        return warnings;
    }
    
    void render_boot_page(uint8_t page)
    {
        if (!display_ready)
        {
            return;
        }
    
        display.clear();
        display.setCursor(0, 0);
        display.setTextSize(1);
        if (page == 0)
        {
            display.printf("BOOT %s WARN:%u\n", boot_complete ? "DONE" : "RUNNING", warning_count());
            display.printf("DRIVES %u/4  IMU %s\n",
                           boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(BootComponent::DRIVES)].detail,
                           state_text(BootComponent::IMU));
            display.printf("OLED %s NRF %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::OLED),
                           state_text(BootComponent::RADIO));
            display.printf("CAN %s  I2C %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::CAN),
                           state_text(BootComponent::I2C));
        }
        else if (page == 1)
        {
            display.printf("MCU PERIPHERALS\n");
            display.printf("UART1 %s UART4 %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::IMU_UART),
                           state_text(BootComponent::LOG_UART));
            display.printf("SPI %s  ADC %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::SPI),
                           state_text(BootComponent::ANALOG_INPUT));
            display.printf("GPIO %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::GPIO));
        }
        else
        {
            display.printf("ROBOT SUBSYSTEMS\n");
            display.printf("KICKER %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::KICKER));
            display.printf("CHASSIS %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::CHASSIS));
            display.printf("ODOMETER %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::ODOMETER));
        }
        display.flush();
    }
    }  // namespace
    
    void begin_boot_report(bool is_display_ready)
    {
        display_ready = is_display_ready;
        boot_report_active = true;
        boot_complete = false;
        boot_report_started = drivers::system_clock::micros();
        for (BootStatus &status : boot_status)
        {
            status = {};
        }
        set_boot_status(BootComponent::OLED, display_ready ? BootState::OK : BootState::FAILED);
        render_boot_page(0);
    }
    
    void set_boot_status(BootComponent component, BootState state, uint8_t detail)
    {
        if (component >= BootComponent::COUNT)
        {
            return;
        }
        BootStatus &status = boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(component)];
        status.state = state;
        status.detail = detail;
        render_boot_page(0);
    }
    
    void finish_boot_report()
    {
        boot_complete = true;
        boot_report_started = drivers::system_clock::micros();
        render_boot_page(0);
    }
    
    void screen()
    {
        if (!display_ready)
        {
            return;
        }
    
        if (boot_report_active)
        {
            constexpr uint32_t report_duration_us = 15000000;
            constexpr uint32_t page_duration_us = 3000000;
            uint32_t elapsed = drivers::system_clock::micros() - boot_report_started;
            if (elapsed < report_duration_us)
            {
                render_boot_page(static_cast<uint8_t>((elapsed / page_duration_us) % 3));
                return;
            }
            boot_report_active = false;
        }
        // static uint32_t last_click = 0;
        // static bool is_updating = true;
    
        static bool was_id_changed = false;
    
        static int counter = 0;
        int version_len = strlen(FIRMWARE_VERSION);
        int version_field_width = 10;
        char vbuf[version_field_width + 1] = {' '};
    
        // https://www.desmos.com/calculator/goy31sxinl
        int t2 = 10;
        int a = version_len > version_field_width ? version_len - version_field_width : 0;
        int t1 = t2 - a;
    
        int A = MIN(MAX(counter - (t1 + a), 0), a);
        int B = MIN(MAX(counter - (t2 + t2 + a), 0), a);
    
        int offset = A - B;
    
        strncpy(vbuf, FIRMWARE_VERSION + offset, version_field_width);
        if (version_len < version_field_width)
        {
            for (size_t i = version_len; i < version_field_width; i++)
            {
                vbuf[i] = ' ';
            }
        }
        vbuf[version_field_width] = '\0';
    
        display.rectFill(0, 0, 126, 32, false);  // Очищаем область
        display.setCursor(0, 0);
        display.setTextSize(1);
        display.printf(
            "robot  %2d%c|%s---------------------x: %6.3f |y: %6.3f\ntheta: %6.3f v: %6.1f",
            devices::robot_dev.robot_id, was_id_changed ? '*' : ' ', vbuf, offset,
            devices::robot_dev.pos_global_current.x, devices::robot_dev.pos_global_current.y,
            devices::robot_dev.pos_global_current.theta, devices::kicker_drv.actual_voltage);
    
        counter++;
        if (counter > a + a + t1 + t2)
        {
            counter = 0;
        }
    
        drivers::out_pins[drivers::LED_DRV1].write(drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_ADDR_UP].read());
        drivers::out_pins[drivers::LED_DRV2].write(drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_ADDR_DOWN].read());
        drivers::out_pins[drivers::LED_DRV3].write(drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_SELECT].read());
        drivers::out_pins[drivers::LED_STM32].toggle();
    
        static bool old_up = false;
        static bool old_down = false;
        static bool old_select = false;
    
        if (drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_ADDR_UP].read())
        {
            was_id_changed = true;
            devices::robot_dev.inc_id();
        }
        if (drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_ADDR_DOWN].read())
        {
            was_id_changed = true;
            devices::robot_dev.dec_id();
        }
    
        static int save_progress = 0;
    
        if (drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_SELECT].read())
        if (drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_SELECT].read())
        {
            save_progress++;
        }
        else
        {
            save_progress = 0;
        }
    
        if (save_progress != 0)
        {
            display.clear();
            display.setCursor(0, 0);
            display.setTextSize(1);
            display.printf("    Hold to save    \n settings to EEPROM \n");
            display.printf("     [");
            for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++)
            {
                display.printf("%c", i <= save_progress ? '#' : ' ');
            }
            display.printf("]");
        }
    
        if (save_progress > 10)
        {
            kinfo("Saving robot config to EEPROM");
            display.clear();
            display.setCursor(0, 0);
            display.setTextSize(1);
            display.printf("Saving robot\nconfig to EEPROM and\nrebooting...");
            display.flush();
    
            devices::eeprom::put(0, static_cast<devices::robot::RobotSettings>(devices::robot_dev));
            kernel::reboot();
        }
    
        old_up = drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_ADDR_UP].read();
        old_down = drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_ADDR_DOWN].read();
        old_select = drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_SELECT].read();
    
        // if (old_up || old_down || old_select)

    void init(drivers::InitStatus driver_status)
    {
        shell::my_shellInit();
        if (driver_status.uart4)
        {
            logger::init();
        }
        // char buffer[128];
        // int rem = sizeof(init_message) % sizeof(buffer);
        // snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%s", init_message);
        // logPrintln("%s", buffer);
        if (driver_status.uart4)
        {
            shellWriteString(&shell::shell, init_message);
        }
        kinfo("Shell initialized");
        kinfo("Logger initialized");
        bool oled_initialized = driver_status.i2c && oled_drv.init();
        apps::screen::begin_boot_report(oled_initialized);
        apps::screen::set_boot_status(
            apps::screen::BootComponent::CAN,
            driver_status.can ? apps::screen::BootState::OK : apps::screen::BootState::FAILED);
        apps::screen::set_boot_status(
            apps::screen::BootComponent::IMU_UART,
            driver_status.uart1 ? apps::screen::BootState::OK : apps::screen::BootState::FAILED);
        apps::screen::set_boot_status(
            apps::screen::BootComponent::LOG_UART,
            driver_status.uart4 ? apps::screen::BootState::OK : apps::screen::BootState::FAILED);
        apps::screen::set_boot_status(
            apps::screen::BootComponent::I2C,
            driver_status.i2c ? apps::screen::BootState::OK : apps::screen::BootState::FAILED);
        apps::screen::set_boot_status(
            apps::screen::BootComponent::SPI,
            driver_status.spi ? apps::screen::BootState::OK : apps::screen::BootState::FAILED);
        apps::screen::set_boot_status(
            apps::screen::BootComponent::ANALOG_INPUT,
            driver_status.adc ? apps::screen::BootState::OK : apps::screen::BootState::FAILED);
        apps::screen::set_boot_status(apps::screen::BootComponent::GPIO,
                                      apps::screen::BootState::READY);
        if (oled_initialized)
        {
            kinfo("OLED initialized");
        }
    
        bool radio_initialized = driver_status.spi && !nrf24_recv.init();
        apps::screen::set_boot_status(
            apps::screen::BootComponent::RADIO,
            radio_initialized ? apps::screen::BootState::OK : apps::screen::BootState::FAILED);
        if (!radio_initialized)
        {
            kerror("NRF24 initialization failed");
        }
        else
        {
            kinfo("NRF24 initialized");
        }
    
        bool bno055_initialized = false;
        for (size_t i = 0; driver_status.uart1 && i < 5; i++)
        {
            bool bno055_init = bno055_drv.check();
            if (!bno055_init)
            {
                kerror("BNO055 offline");
                if (!bno055_drv.reset())
                {
                    HAL_Delay(100);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                kinfo("BNO055 online");
                bool config_mode_ok = bno055_drv.setmode(OPERATION_MODE_CONFIG);
                bool angle_units_ok = config_mode_ok && bno055_drv.set_angle_units(RADIANS);
                bool rate_units_ok = angle_units_ok && bno055_drv.set_anglerate_units(RAD_PER_SEC);
                bool ndof_mode_ok = rate_units_ok && bno055_drv.setmode(OPERATION_MODE_NDOF);
                if (ndof_mode_ok)
                {
                    kinfo("BNO055 initialized");
                    bno055_initialized = true;
                    break;
                }
    
                kerror("BNO055 configuration failed");
                if (!bno055_drv.reset())
                {
                    HAL_Delay(100);
                }
            }
        }
        if (!bno055_initialized)
        {
            kerror("BNO055 initialization failed after retries");
        }
        apps::screen::set_boot_status(
            apps::screen::BootComponent::IMU,
            bno055_initialized ? apps::screen::BootState::OK : apps::screen::BootState::FAILED);
    
        uint8_t drive_feedback_mask = bldcs_drv.init();
        uint8_t drive_count = 0;
        for (uint8_t i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
        {
            drive_count += (drive_feedback_mask >> i) & 1U;
        }
        apps::screen::set_boot_status(apps::screen::BootComponent::DRIVES,
                                      drive_count == 4
                                          ? apps::screen::BootState::OK
                                          : (drive_count == 0 ? apps::screen::BootState::FAILED
                                                              : apps::screen::BootState::WARNING),
                                      drive_count);
        if (drive_count == 4)
        {
            kinfo("BLDC initialized");
        }
    
        chassis_drv.init();
        apps::screen::set_boot_status(apps::screen::BootComponent::CHASSIS,
                                      apps::screen::BootState::READY);
        kinfo("Chassis initialized");
    
        odom_dev.init();
        apps::screen::set_boot_status(apps::screen::BootComponent::ODOMETER,
                                      apps::screen::BootState::READY);
        kinfo("Odometer initialized");
    
        robot_settings.signature = robot::calculate_signature(robot_settings);
    
        robot::RobotSettings eeprom_robot_settings = {0};
    
        eeprom::get(0, eeprom_robot_settings);
    
        if (eeprom_robot_settings.signature != robot_settings.signature)
        {
            kwarning("EEPROM signature mismatch, saving settings to EEPROM");
            eeprom::put(0, robot_settings);
        }
        else
        {
            kinfo("EEPROM signature match");
            kinfo("Updating robot settings from EEPROM");
            kinfo("  id: %d", eeprom_robot_settings.robot_id);
            robot_dev.init(eeprom_robot_settings);
        }
    
        kinfo("Robot initialized");
    
        kicker_drv.init();
        apps::screen::set_boot_status(apps::screen::BootComponent::KICKER,
                                      apps::screen::BootState::READY);
        kinfo("Kicker initialized");
        // kinfo("AUAUSDUASDUDevices initialized");
    
        IRQ_Init();
        nrf24_recv.recv_irq();
        kinfo("Devices initialized");
        apps::screen::finish_boot_report();
        apps::screen::screen();
    }

    void init()
    {
        is_init = true;
    
        while (true)
        {
            yield();
        }
    }
    
    void sleep_ms(uint32_t sleep_ms)
    {
        sleep_us(sleep_ms * 1000);
    }
    
    void sleep_us(uint32_t sleep_us)
    {
        uint32_t start = drivers::system_clock::micros();
        while (drivers::system_clock::micros() - start < sleep_us)
        {
            yield();
        }
    }
    
    TaskDescriptor *get_tasks()
    {
        return tasks;
    }
    
    
    size_t get_task_count()
    {
        return app_count;
    }

        46    uint8_t warning_count()
        47    {
        48        uint8_t warnings = 0;
        49        for (const BootStatus &status : boot_status)
        50        {
        51            if (status.state == BootState::WARNING || status.state == BootState::FAILED ||
        52                (boot_complete && status.state == BootState::PENDING))
        53            {
        54                warnings++;
        55            }
        56        }
        57        return warnings;
        58    }
        59
        60    void render_boot_page(uint8_t page)
        61    {
        62        if (!display_ready)
        63        {
        64            return;
        65        }
        66
        67        display.clear();
        68        display.setCursor(0, 0);
        69        display.setTextSize(1);
        70        if (page == 0)
        71        {
        72            display.printf("BOOT %s WARN:%u\n", boot_complete ? "DONE" : "RUNNING", warning_count());
        73            display.printf("DRIVES %u/4  IMU %s\n",
        74                           boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(BootComponent::DRIVES)].detail,
        75                           state_text(BootComponent::IMU));
        76            display.printf("OLED %s NRF %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::OLED),
        77                           state_text(BootComponent::RADIO));
        78            display.printf("CAN %s  I2C %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::CAN),
        79                           state_text(BootComponent::I2C));
        80        }
        81        else if (page == 1)
        82        {
        83            display.printf("MCU PERIPHERALS\n");
        84            display.printf("UART1 %s UART4 %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::IMU_UART),
        85                           state_text(BootComponent::LOG_UART));
        86            display.printf("SPI %s  ADC %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::SPI),
        87                           state_text(BootComponent::ANALOG_INPUT));
        88            display.printf("GPIO %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::GPIO));
        89        }
        90        else
        91        {
        92            display.printf("ROBOT SUBSYSTEMS\n");
        93            display.printf("KICKER %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::KICKER));
        94            display.printf("CHASSIS %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::CHASSIS));
        95            display.printf("ODOMETER %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::ODOMETER));
        96        }
        97        display.flush();
        98    }

       101    void begin_boot_report(bool is_display_ready)
       102    {
       103        display_ready = is_display_ready;
       104        boot_report_active = true;
       105        boot_complete = false;
       106        boot_report_started = drivers::system_clock::micros();
       107        for (BootStatus &status : boot_status)

       109            status = {};

       115    void set_boot_status(BootComponent component, BootState state, uint8_t detail)
       116    {
       117        if (component >= BootComponent::COUNT)

       119            return;
       120        }
       121        BootStatus &status = boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(component)];
       122        status.state = state;
       123        status.detail = detail;
       124        render_boot_page(0);
       125    }

       127    void finish_boot_report()
       128    {
       129        boot_complete = true;
       130        boot_report_started = drivers::system_clock::micros();
       131        render_boot_page(0);

     namespace apps::screen

    +namespace
    +{
    +struct BootStatus
    +{
    +    BootState state = BootState::PENDING;
    +    uint8_t detail = 0;
    +};
    +
    +BootStatus boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(BootComponent::COUNT)];
    +bool display_ready = false;
    +bool boot_report_active = false;
    +bool boot_complete = false;
    +uint32_t boot_report_started = 0;
    +constexpr uint32_t report_duration_us = 15000000;
    +constexpr uint32_t page_duration_us = 3000000;
    +constexpr uint8_t boot_page_count = 5;
    +
    +uint8_t drive_count()
    +{
    +    uint8_t count = 0;
    +    uint8_t mask = boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(BootComponent::DRIVES)].detail;
    +    for (uint8_t index = 0; index < 4; ++index)
    +    {
    +        count += (mask >> index) & 1U;
    +    }
    +    return count;
    +}
    +
    +const char *state_text(BootComponent component)
    +{
    +    switch (boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(component)].state)
    +    {
    +        case BootState::OK:
    +            return "OK";
    +        case BootState::READY:
    +            return "READY";
    +        case BootState::WARNING:
    +            return "WARN";
    +        case BootState::FAILED:
    +            return "FAIL";
    +        default:
    +            return "WAIT";
    +    }
    +}
    +
    +uint8_t warning_count()
    +{
    +    uint8_t warnings = 0;
    +    for (const BootStatus &status : boot_status)
    +    {
    +        if (status.state == BootState::WARNING || status.state == BootState::FAILED ||
    +            (boot_complete && status.state == BootState::PENDING))
    +        {
    +            warnings++;
    +        }
    +    }
    +    return warnings;
    +}
    +
    +void render_boot_page(uint8_t page, uint32_t elapsed)
    +{
    +    if (!display_ready)
    +    {
    +        return;
    +    }
    +
    +    display.clear();
    +    display.setCursor(0, 0);
    +    display.setTextSize(1);
    +    if (page == 0)
    +    {
    +        display.printf("BOOT %s WARN:%u\n", boot_complete ? "DONE" : "RUN", warning_count());
    +        display.printf("DRIVES %u/4 IMU %s\n", drive_count(), state_text(BootComponent::IMU));
    +        display.printf("OLED %s NRF %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::OLED),
    +                       state_text(BootComponent::RADIO));
    +        display.printf("CAN %s  I2C %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::CAN),
    +                       state_text(BootComponent::I2C));
    +    }
    +    else if (page == 1)
    +    {
    +        display.printf("MCU PERIPHERALS\n");
    +        display.printf("UART1 %s UART4 %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::IMU_UART),
    +                       state_text(BootComponent::LOG_UART));
    +        display.printf("SPI %s  ADC %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::SPI),
    +                       state_text(BootComponent::ANALOG_INPUT));
    +        display.printf("GPIO %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::GPIO));
    +    }
    +    else if (page == 2)
    +    {
    +        display.printf("ROBOT SUBSYSTEMS\n");
    +        display.printf("KICKER %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::KICKER));
    +        display.printf("CHASSIS %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::CHASSIS));
    +        display.printf("ODOMETER %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::ODOMETER));
    +    }
    +    else if (page == 3)
    +    {
    +        display.printf("BUS ERRORS\n");
    +        display.printf(
    +            "CAN %s %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::CAN),
    +            boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(BootComponent::CAN)].state == BootState::FAILED
    +                ? "check bus/power"
    +                : "");
    +        display.printf(
    +            "I2C %s %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::I2C),
    +            boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(BootComponent::I2C)].state == BootState::FAILED
    +                ? "check bus/pins"
    +                : "");
    +        display.printf("SPI %s U1 %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::SPI),
    +                       state_text(BootComponent::IMU_UART));
    +    }
    +    else
    +    {
    +        display.printf("DEVICE ERRORS\n");
    +        BootState imu_state = boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(BootComponent::IMU)].state;
    +        display.printf("IMU %s %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::IMU),
    +                       imu_state == BootState::FAILED
    +                           ? (boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(BootComponent::IMU_UART)].state ==
    +                                      BootState::FAILED
    +                                  ? "UART1 init"
    +                                  : "no reply/config")
    +                           : "");
    +        uint8_t mask = boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(BootComponent::DRIVES)].detail;
    +        display.printf("DRIVES %u/4 mask:%X\n", drive_count(), mask);
    +        display.printf("NRF %s ADC %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::RADIO),
    +                       state_text(BootComponent::ANALOG_INPUT));
    +    }
    +
    +    display.setCursor(108, 0);
    +    display.printf("%u/%u", page + 1, boot_page_count);
    +    uint32_t remaining = elapsed >= report_duration_us ? 0 : report_duration_us - elapsed;
    +    int bar_width = static_cast<int>((remaining * 12U) / report_duration_us);
    +    display.rect(114, 25, 13, 7, true);
    +    display.rectFill(115, 26, bar_width, 5, true);
    +    display.flush();
    +}
    +}  // namespace
    +
    +void begin_boot_report(bool is_display_ready)
    +{
    +    display_ready = is_display_ready;
    +    boot_report_active = true;
    +    boot_complete = false;
    +    boot_report_started = drivers::system_clock::micros();
    +    for (BootStatus &status : boot_status)
    +    {
    +        status = {};
    +    }
    +    set_boot_status(BootComponent::OLED, display_ready ? BootState::OK : BootState::FAILED);
    +    render_boot_page(0, 0);
    +}
    +
    +void set_boot_status(BootComponent component, BootState state, uint8_t detail)
    +{
    +    if (component >= BootComponent::COUNT)
    +    {
    +        return;
    +    }
    +    BootStatus &status = boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(component)];
    +    status.state = state;
    +    status.detail = detail;
    +    render_boot_page(0, drivers::system_clock::micros() - boot_report_started);
    +}
    +
    +void finish_boot_report()
    +{
    +    boot_complete = true;
    +    boot_report_started = drivers::system_clock::micros();
    +    render_boot_page(0, 0);
    +}
    +
     void screen()
     {
    +    if (!display_ready)
    +    {
    +        return;
    +    }
    +
    +    if (boot_report_active)
    +    {
    +        uint32_t elapsed = drivers::system_clock::micros() - boot_report_started;
    +        if (elapsed < report_duration_us)
    +        {
    +            render_boot_page(static_cast<uint8_t>((elapsed / page_duration_us) % boot_page_count),
    +                             elapsed);
    +            return;
    +        }
    +        boot_report_active = false;
    +    }

    CanDriver::CanDriver(CanConfig config) : CanConfig(config) {}
    
    bool CanDriver::init()
    {
        initialized_ = false;
        clk_enable();
    
        GPIO_InitTypeDef GPIO_InitStruct;
    
        // TX pin configuration
        GPIO_InitStruct.Pin = txPin;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Mode = GPIO_MODE_AF_PP;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Pull = GPIO_NOPULL;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Speed = GPIO_SPEED_FREQ_HIGH;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Alternate = txAlternate;
    
        HAL_GPIO_Init(txPort, &GPIO_InitStruct);
    
        // RX pin configuration
        GPIO_InitStruct.Pin = rxPin;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Alternate = rxAlternate;
    
        HAL_GPIO_Init(rxPort, &GPIO_InitStruct);
    
        handle.Instance = instance;
    
        handle.Init.Prescaler = prescaler;
        handle.Init.Mode = mode;
        handle.Init.SyncJumpWidth = sjw;
        handle.Init.TimeSeg1 = timeSeg1;
        handle.Init.TimeSeg2 = timeSeg2;
        handle.Init.TimeTriggeredMode = timeTriggeredMode;
        handle.Init.AutoBusOff = autoBusOff;
        handle.Init.AutoWakeUp = autoWakeUp;
        handle.Init.AutoRetransmission = autoRetrans;
        handle.Init.ReceiveFifoLocked = receiveFifoLocked;
        handle.Init.TransmitFifoPriority = transmitFifoPriority;
    
        can1_driver = this;
    
        HAL_StatusTypeDef status = HAL_CAN_Init(&handle);
        if (status != HAL_OK)
        {
            uint32_t error = HAL_CAN_GetError(&handle);
            kerror("CAN init error: %d, error code: %lu\n", int(status), error);
            return false;
        }
    
        // Configure a filter to allow all messages (standard ID)
        CAN_FilterTypeDef sFilterConfig;
        sFilterConfig.FilterBank = 0;
        sFilterConfig.FilterMode = CAN_FILTERMODE_IDMASK;
        sFilterConfig.FilterScale = CAN_FILTERSCALE_32BIT;
        sFilterConfig.FilterIdHigh = 0x0000;
        sFilterConfig.FilterIdLow = 0x0000;
        sFilterConfig.FilterMaskIdHigh = 0x0000;
        sFilterConfig.FilterMaskIdLow = 0x0000;
        sFilterConfig.FilterFIFOAssignment = CAN_RX_FIFO0;
        sFilterConfig.FilterActivation = ENABLE;
        sFilterConfig.SlaveStartFilterBank = 14;
    
        status = HAL_CAN_ConfigFilter(&handle, &sFilterConfig);
        if (status != HAL_OK)
        {
            uint32_t error = HAL_CAN_GetError(&handle);
            kerror("CAN filter config error: %d, error code: %lu\n", int(status), error);
            return false;
        }
    
        status = HAL_CAN_Start(&handle);
        if (status != HAL_OK)
        {
            uint32_t error = HAL_CAN_GetError(&handle);
            kerror("CAN start error: %d, error code: %lu\n", int(status), error);
            return false;
        }
    
        HAL_NVIC_SetPriority(CAN1_RX0_IRQn, 5, 0);
        HAL_NVIC_EnableIRQ(CAN1_RX0_IRQn);
    
        status = HAL_CAN_ActivateNotification(&handle,
                                              CAN_IT_RX_FIFO0_MSG_PENDING | CAN_IT_RX_FIFO0_OVERRUN);
        if (status != HAL_OK)
        {
            uint32_t error = HAL_CAN_GetError(&handle);
            kerror("CAN RX notification error: %d, error code: %lu\n", int(status), error);
            return false;
        }
        initialized_ = true;
        return true;
    }

    namespace apps::screen
