    namespace
    {
    struct BootStatus
    {
        BootState state = BootState::PENDING;
        uint8_t detail = 0;
    };
    
    BootStatus boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(BootComponent::COUNT)];
    bool display_ready = false;
    bool boot_report_active = false;
    bool boot_complete = false;
    uint32_t boot_report_started = 0;
    constexpr uint32_t report_duration_us = 15000000;
    constexpr uint32_t page_duration_us = 3000000;
    constexpr uint8_t boot_page_count = 5;
    
    uint8_t drive_count()
    {
        uint8_t count = 0;
        uint8_t mask = boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(BootComponent::DRIVES)].detail;
        for (uint8_t index = 0; index < 4; ++index)
        {
            count += (mask >> index) & 1U;
        }
        return count;
    }
    
    void format_missing_drive_ids(uint8_t feedback_mask, char output[24])
    {
        size_t length = 0;
        const char prefix[] = "MISS IDs:";
        for (size_t index = 0; index < sizeof(prefix) - 1; ++index)
        {
            output[length++] = prefix[index];
        }
    
        bool first = true;
        for (uint8_t index = 0; index < 4; ++index)
        {
            if ((feedback_mask & (1U << index)) != 0)
            {
                continue;
            }
            if (!first)
            {
                output[length++] = ',';
            }
            output[length++] = 'M';
            output[length++] = static_cast<char>('1' + index);
            first = false;
        }
        output[length] = '\0';
    }
    
    const char *state_text(BootComponent component)
    {
        switch (boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(component)].state)
        {
            case BootState::OK:
                return "OK";
            case BootState::READY:
                return "READY";
            case BootState::WARNING:
                return "WARN";
            case BootState::FAILED:
                return "FAIL";
            default:
                return "WAIT";
        }
    }
    
    uint8_t warning_count()
    {
        uint8_t warnings = 0;
        for (const BootStatus &status : boot_status)
        {
            if (status.state == BootState::WARNING || status.state == BootState::FAILED ||
                (boot_complete && status.state == BootState::PENDING))
            {
                warnings++;
            }
        }
        return warnings;
    }
    
    void render_boot_page(uint8_t page, uint32_t elapsed)
    {
        if (!display_ready)
        {
            return;
        }
    
        display.clear();
        display.setCursor(0, 0);
        display.setTextSize(1);
        if (page == 0)
        {
            display.printf("BOOT %s WARN:%u\n", boot_complete ? "DONE" : "RUN", warning_count());
            display.printf("DRIVES %u/4 IMU %s\n", drive_count(), state_text(BootComponent::IMU));
            display.printf("OLED %s NRF %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::OLED),
                           state_text(BootComponent::RADIO));
            display.printf("CAN %s  I2C %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::CAN),
                           state_text(BootComponent::I2C));
        }
        else if (page == 1)
        {
            display.printf("MCU PERIPHERALS\n");
            display.printf("U1 %s U4 %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::IMU_UART),
                           state_text(BootComponent::LOG_UART));
            display.printf("SPI %s  ADC %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::SPI),
                           state_text(BootComponent::ANALOG_INPUT));
            display.printf("GPIO %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::GPIO));
        }
        else if (page == 2)
        {
            display.printf("ROBOT SUBSYSTEMS\n");
            display.printf("KICKER %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::KICKER));
            display.printf("CHASSIS %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::CHASSIS));
            display.printf("ODOMETER %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::ODOMETER));
        }
        else if (page == 3)
        {
            display.printf("BUS ERRORS\n");
            display.printf(
                "CAN %s %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::CAN),
                boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(BootComponent::CAN)].state == BootState::FAILED
                    ? "HAL/filter/RX"
                    : "");
            display.printf(
                "I2C %s %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::I2C),
                boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(BootComponent::I2C)].state == BootState::FAILED
                    ? "HAL init"
                    : "");
            display.printf("SPI %s U1 %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::SPI),
                           state_text(BootComponent::IMU_UART));
        }
        else
        {
            display.printf("DEVICE ERRORS\n");
            BootState imu_state = boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(BootComponent::IMU)].state;
            uint8_t imu_detail = boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(BootComponent::IMU)].detail;
            const char *imu_error = imu_detail == 1   ? "UART1 init"
                                    : imu_detail == 2 ? "no UART reply"
                                    : imu_detail == 3 ? "config/mode fail"
                                                      : "";
            display.printf("IMU %s %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::IMU),
                           imu_state == BootState::FAILED ? imu_error : "");
            uint8_t mask = boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(BootComponent::DRIVES)].detail;
            display.printf("DRIVES %u/4 mask:%X\n", drive_count(), mask);
            if (drive_count() < 4)
            {
                char missing_ids[24];
                format_missing_drive_ids(mask, missing_ids);
                display.printf("%s\n", missing_ids);
            }
            else
            {
                display.printf("NRF %s ADC %s\n", state_text(BootComponent::RADIO),
                               state_text(BootComponent::ANALOG_INPUT));
            }
        }
    
        display.setCursor(108, 0);
        display.printf("%u/%u", page + 1, boot_page_count);
        uint32_t remaining = elapsed >= report_duration_us ? 0 : report_duration_us - elapsed;
        int bar_width = static_cast<int>((remaining * 12U) / report_duration_us);
        display.rect(114, 25, 13, 7, true);
        display.rectFill(115, 26, bar_width, 5, true);
        display.flush();
    }
    }  // namespace
    
    void begin_boot_report(bool is_display_ready)
    {
        display_ready = is_display_ready;
        boot_report_active = true;
        boot_complete = false;
        boot_report_started = drivers::system_clock::micros();
        for (BootStatus &status : boot_status)
        {
            status = {};
        }
        set_boot_status(BootComponent::OLED, display_ready ? BootState::OK : BootState::FAILED);
        render_boot_page(0, 0);
    }
    
    void set_boot_status(BootComponent component, BootState state, uint8_t detail)
    {
        if (component >= BootComponent::COUNT)
        {
            return;
        }
        BootStatus &status = boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(component)];
        status.state = state;
        status.detail = detail;
        render_boot_page(0, drivers::system_clock::micros() - boot_report_started);
    }
    
    void finish_boot_report()
    {
        boot_complete = true;
        boot_report_started = drivers::system_clock::micros();
        render_boot_page(0, 0);
    }
    
    void screen()
    {
        if (!display_ready)
        {
            return;
        }
    
        if (boot_report_active)
        {
            uint32_t elapsed = drivers::system_clock::micros() - boot_report_started;
            if (elapsed < report_duration_us)
            {
                render_boot_page(static_cast<uint8_t>((elapsed / page_duration_us) % boot_page_count),
                                 elapsed);
                return;
            }
            boot_report_active = false;
        }
        // static uint32_t last_click = 0;
        // static bool is_updating = true;
        // static bool is_updating = true;
    
        static bool was_id_changed = false;
    
        static int counter = 0;
        int version_len = strlen(FIRMWARE_VERSION);
        int version_field_width = 10;
        char vbuf[version_field_width + 1] = {' '};
    
        // https://www.desmos.com/calculator/goy31sxinl
        int t2 = 10;
        int a = version_len > version_field_width ? version_len - version_field_width : 0;
        int t1 = t2 - a;
    
        int A = MIN(MAX(counter - (t1 + a), 0), a);
        int B = MIN(MAX(counter - (t2 + t2 + a), 0), a);
    
        int offset = A - B;
    
        strncpy(vbuf, FIRMWARE_VERSION + offset, version_field_width);
        if (version_len < version_field_width)
        {
            for (size_t i = version_len; i < version_field_width; i++)
            {
                vbuf[i] = ' ';
            }
        }
        vbuf[version_field_width] = '\0';
    
        display.rectFill(0, 0, 126, 32, false);  // Очищаем область
        display.setCursor(0, 0);
        display.setTextSize(1);
        display.printf(
            "robot  %2d%c|%s---------------------x: %6.3f |y: %6.3f\ntheta: %6.3f v: %6.1f",
            devices::robot_dev.robot_id, was_id_changed ? '*' : ' ', vbuf, offset,
            devices::robot_dev.pos_global_current.x, devices::robot_dev.pos_global_current.y,
            devices::robot_dev.pos_global_current.theta, devices::kicker_drv.actual_voltage);
    
        counter++;
        if (counter > a + a + t1 + t2)
        {
            counter = 0;
        }
    
        drivers::out_pins[drivers::LED_DRV1].write(drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_ADDR_UP].read());
        drivers::out_pins[drivers::LED_DRV2].write(drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_ADDR_DOWN].read());
        drivers::out_pins[drivers::LED_DRV3].write(drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_SELECT].read());
        drivers::out_pins[drivers::LED_STM32].toggle();
    
        static bool old_up = false;
        static bool old_down = false;
        static bool old_select = false;
    
        if (drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_ADDR_UP].read())
        {
            was_id_changed = true;
            devices::robot_dev.inc_id();
        }
        if (drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_ADDR_DOWN].read())
        {
            was_id_changed = true;
            devices::robot_dev.dec_id();
        }
    
        static int save_progress = 0;
    
        if (drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_SELECT].read())
        {
            save_progress++;
        }
        else
        {
            save_progress = 0;
        }
    
        if (save_progress != 0)
        {
            display.clear();
            display.setCursor(0, 0);
            display.setTextSize(1);
            display.printf("    Hold to save    \n settings to EEPROM \n");
            display.printf("     [");
            for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++)
            {
                display.printf("%c", i <= save_progress ? '#' : ' ');
            }
            display.printf("]");

        if (save_progress > 10)

            kinfo("Saving robot config to EEPROM");
            display.clear();
            display.setCursor(0, 0);
            display.setTextSize(1);
            display.printf("Saving robot\nconfig to EEPROM and\nrebooting...");
            display.flush();
    
            devices::eeprom::put(0, static_cast<devices::robot::RobotSettings>(devices::robot_dev));
            kernel::reboot();
        }
    
        old_up = drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_ADDR_UP].read();
        old_down = drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_ADDR_DOWN].read();

    # Bounded task QA contracts
    
    Use during task segmentation, before creating implementation and verification
    work items. Revisit only affected contracts when requirements or inputs change.
    This is a planning aid, not a new council, test framework or approval layer.
    
    ## Refine with the user and specialists
    
    1. Extract observable delivery criteria, deferred behavior, physical permissions
       and time/cost constraints from the user and authoritative project decisions.
    2. Reuse existing specialist findings. Label inputs **verified** (with a source),
       **proposed**, or **unknown**; agent summaries alone are not verified evidence.
    3. Ask only consequential unresolved questions. Delegated reversible decisions
       may proceed within their stated authority. Specialist suggestions do not
       silently add requirements or reduce acceptance criteria.
    4. Map each criterion to implementation and verification owners. Parallelize
       disjoint outputs; keep one owner for shared integration files and fixtures.
    5. Return contracts and unresolved decisions, not another large design dossier.
    
    ## Per-task contract
    
    Record this in the work item or the project's existing planning format:
    
    - **Outcome:** observable behavior and explicit non-goals.
    - **Inputs:** frozen source revision plus uncommitted/new-file manifest when
      applicable; toolchain/configuration, approved interfaces, missing prerequisites.
    - **Owner/scope:** writable files, interfaces, shared resources and collaborators.
    - **Deliverables:** source changes and all new files, dependency configuration
      and applicable licence notices, image if built, hashes and evidence locations.
    - **Integration:** build inclusion, stable ID/registry, actual implementation
      invocation, boot/resume hooks and user-facing selection where applicable.
    - **Checks:** exact existing commands, fixtures, assertions and one executor per
      check. Include negative/error cleanup checks relevant to the change.
    - **Reuse:** previous result IDs and their input/configuration identity; list
      changes that invalidate them. Reuse evidence, not unverified PASS summaries.
    - **Bounds:** executable stages, command timeouts, checkpoint destination and one
      bounded correction attempt. Estimate from actual stages, not a universal call
      count. A small isolated defect need not acquire a formal multi-agent workflow.
    - **Stop:** missing source, confirmed blocker, exhausted cost/time budget or owner
      cancellation. A retry requires new evidence or a materially changed plan.
    - **Verdict:** PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN/INCOMPLETE by evidence level; separate physical
      acceptance from software completion. Completing a review can mean REVISE.
    - **Consumer:** downstream task and exact artifact it consumes.
    
    For storage exclusivity, test both competing entry points: recorder claim while
    raw access is active, and raw-write refusal while recording/mounted. Test safe
    release after failure. For standby, registration alone is insufficient: account
    for platform operations and boot/reset continuation, not a NOT_RUN placeholder.
    These are risk examples, not requirements for every embedded feature.
    
    ## QA entry gate: source-complete, frozen and recoverable
    
    Before starting an expensive matrix, verify that the consumer can extract the
    bundle from its durable destination and match declared hashes. A committed
    revision may provide existing source; include all additional uncommitted/new
    source, configuration, dependency and licence files needed to reproduce it.
    Objects, an ELF, or a summary alone cannot replace missing source. Do not create
    an empty stub to satisfy a file-list or registry check.
    
    An optional portable hash checker is provided:
    
    ```text
    python skills/embedded-qa/scripts/verify_handoff.py --root <extracted-bundle> --manifest <manifest.json>
    ```
    
    The JSON format is deliberately small:
    
    ```json
    {
      "schema_version": 1,
      "required_paths": ["src/session.c", "config/storage.h"],
      "artifacts": [
        {"path": "src/session.c", "sha256": "<64 lowercase hex digits>", "role": "source"},
        {"path": "config/storage.h", "sha256": "<64 lowercase hex digits>", "role": "config"}
      ]
    }
    ```
    
    The placeholder hashes above must be replaced with real values. Paths are
    relative to the extracted root; declare required source/config/licence paths
    from the actual build/dependency inventory, not just whatever files survived.
    At least one source artifact is required. Other roles: `license`, `evidence`,
    `firmware`. The checker rejects missing/changed files, duplicate paths, traversal,
    symlinks and malformed manifests. It does **not** discover omitted dependencies,
    validate licences, prove a build, validate a test verdict, or enforce integration.
    A manifest can be self-consistent but incomplete: the entry gate still requires
    comparison against the authoritative build/feature inventory. Run the checker on
    the retrieved durable copy, not only on the producer workspace.
    
    ## Execute once; review independently
    
    - Builder: run affected unit/build checks and preserve machine-readable results.
    - QA: independently verify the agreed candidate/claims at the cheapest faithful
      evidence level; define its oracle independently, not from current output.
    - Reviewer: consume same-input QA evidence and examine code/interfaces/safety.
      Repeat a test only for changed inputs, disputed results or uncovered risk;
      state the reason. Independence does not require duplicating every matrix.
    - Findings: publish the shortest reproduction and REVISE once confirmed blockers
      suffice. Do not keep expanding checks merely to polish a report.
    - Hardware: absent probes, missing flash permission or pending physical timing
      become explicit bench gaps; close the software activity without inventing PASS.
      Do not reduce a real release requirement to a caveat to obtain approval.
    
    ## Stop the retry and publication loops
    
    Preserve a done/remaining checkpoint after the first useful stage, before long
    commands, and on cancellation. A runtime budget is a limit, not proof of useful
    progress. Generic exit code 1 is not a transport diagnosis. Inspect logs and
    artifacts before deciding whether a retry is justified; wall-clock and iteration
    budgets are different and runtime-specific. Do not raise either speculatively.
    
    If an operational choice is reconsidered twice without new evidence, use the
    known supported method once or report a precise tooling blocker. For artifacts,
    use the runtime's direct local-file attachment/upload operation; do not route
    base64 blobs through model context. Verify remote readback and stored hashes.
    If no durable storage is available, report that and retain local source; do not
    claim publication or permit workspace cleanup. Stop/cost-stop instructions end

    #include "imu.hpp"
    
    namespace devices::imu
    {
    
    BNO055::BNO055(BNO055Config &config) : BNO055Config(config)
    {
        address = BNOAddress;
        accel_scale = 0.001f;
        rate_scale = 1.0f / 16.0f;
        angle_scale = 1.0f / 16.0f;
        temp_scale = 1;
    }
    
    bool BNO055::reset()
    {
        online = false;
        if (!readcharreg(BNO055_SYS_TRIGGER_ADDR))
        {
            return false;
        }
        rx = static_cast<char>(static_cast<uint8_t>(rx) | 0x20U);
        if (!writecharreg(BNO055_SYS_TRIGGER_ADDR, rx))
        {
            return false;
        }
        // Wait for the system to come back up again (datasheet says 650ms)
        // wait_ms(675);
        kernel::delay_ms(675);
        return true;
    }
    
    bool BNO055::check()
    {
        online = false;
        // Check we have communication link with the chip
        if (!readcharreg(BNO055_CHIP_ID_ADDR) || static_cast<uint8_t>(rx) != 0xA0)
            return false;
        // Grab the chip ID and software versions

        bool readmulreg(char reg_addr, char *buff, size_t buff_size)
        {

            {

            }
            tx[0] = 0xAA;  // Start byte
            tx[1] = 0x01;  // Read
            tx[2] = reg_addr;
            tx[3] = buff_size;

                       static_cast<uint8_t>(reg_addr), static_cast<unsigned>(buff_size),
                       static_cast<int>(status), static_cast<uint8_t>(rx_buff[0]),
                       static_cast<uint8_t>(rx_buff[1]));
                return false;
            }
    
            for (size_t i = 0; i < buff_size; i++)
            {
                buff[i] = rx_buff[i + 2];
            }

        {

            tx[4] = value;

        {
            tx[0] = 0xAA;  // Start byte
            tx[1] = 0x00;  // Write
            tx[2] = reg_addr;
            tx[3] = buff_size;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < buff_size; i++)
            {
                tx[i + 4] = buff[i];
            }
            uart_drv.write(tx, buff_size + 4);
    
            char rx_buff[2] = {};
            HAL_StatusTypeDef status = uart_drv.read(rx_buff, sizeof(rx_buff), 10000U);
            if (status != HAL_OK || static_cast<uint8_t>(rx_buff[0]) != 0xEE ||
                static_cast<uint8_t>(rx_buff[1]) != 0x01)

                       static_cast<uint8_t>(reg_addr), static_cast<int>(status),
                       static_cast<uint8_t>(rx_buff[0]), static_cast<uint8_t>(rx_buff[1]));
                return;
            }
        }

        tx_dma_busy_ = false;

        __HAL_UART_CLEAR_FEFLAG(&handle);

        restart_rx_dma_();
        tx_try_start_();
    }

    bool UartDriver::init()
    {

        GPIO_InitStruct.Pin = txPin;
        GPIO_InitStruct.Mode = GPIO_MODE_AF_PP;

        while (got < size)

            uint32_t avail = (head + kRxDmaBufSize - rx_dma_tail_) % kRxDmaBufSize;
            if (avail > 0U)
            {
                chunk = static_cast<uint16_t>((avail < static_cast<uint32_t>(size - got))
                                                  ? avail

    void UartDriver::tx_try_start_()
    {
        if (tx_dma_busy_)
        {
            return;
        }
        if (handle.gState != HAL_UART_STATE_READY)
        {
            return;
        }
        if (tx_tail_ == tx_head_)
        {
            return;
        }
    
        uint16_t n = 0;
        uint32_t t = tx_tail_;
        while (n < kTxDmaChunk && t != tx_head_)
        {
            tx_dma_chunk_[n++] = tx_ring_[t];
            t = (t + 1U) % kTxRingSize;
        }
        if (n == 0)
        {
            return;
        }
    
        if (HAL_UART_Transmit_DMA(&handle, tx_dma_chunk_, n) != HAL_OK)
        {
            return;
        }
        tx_dma_busy_ = true;
        tx_tail_ = t;
    }
    
    void UartDriver::tx_push_bytes_(const uint8_t *data, uint16_t size)
    {
        for (uint16_t i = 0; i < size; ++i)
        {
            for (;;)
            {
                uint32_t primask = __get_PRIMASK();
                __disable_irq();
                uint32_t next = (tx_head_ + 1U) % kTxRingSize;
                if (next != tx_tail_)
                {
                    tx_ring_[tx_head_] = data[i];
                    tx_head_ = next;
                    __set_PRIMASK(primask);
                    break;
                }
                __set_PRIMASK(primask);
                kernel::scheduler::yield();
            }
        }
    }
    
    void UartDriver::flush_tx()
    {
        if (!initialized_)
        {
            return;
        }
        for (;;)
        {
            tx_try_start_();
            const bool queue_empty = (tx_head_ == tx_tail_);
            const bool hw_idle = !tx_dma_busy_ && (handle.gState == HAL_UART_STATE_READY);
            if (queue_empty && hw_idle)
            {
                break;
            }
            kernel::scheduler::yield();
        }
    }
    
    void UartDriver::putc(char c)
    {
        if (!initialized_)
        {
            return;
        }
        tx_push_bytes_(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(&c), 1);
        tx_try_start_();
    }
    
    void UartDriver::write(const char *data, uint16_t size)
    {
        if (!initialized_ || data == nullptr || size == 0)
        {
            return;
        }
        tx_push_bytes_(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(data), size);
        tx_try_start_();
        flush_tx();
    }
    
    void UartDriver::printf(const char *fmt, ...)
    {
        va_list args;
        va_start(args, fmt);
        vprintf(fmt, args);
        va_end(args);
    }
    
    void UartDriver::vprintf(const char *fmt, va_list args)
    {
        char buffer[128];
        vsnprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), fmt, args);
        write(buffer, static_cast<uint16_t>(strlen(buffer)));
    }

        47        // writemulreg(address, tx, 1);

        49        ID.id = rawdata[0];
        50        ID.accel = rawdata[1];
        51        ID.mag = rawdata[2];
        52        ID.gyro = rawdata[3];
        53        ID.sw[0] = rawdata[4];
        54        ID.sw[1] = rawdata[5];
        55        ID.bootload = rawdata[6];
        56        if (!setpage(1))
        57        {
        58            return false;
        59        }
        60        tx[0] = BNO055_UNIQUE_ID_ADDR;
        61        // _i2c.write(address, tx, 1, true);
        62        // _i2c.read(address + 1, ID.serial, 16, false);
        63        // writemulreg(address, tx, 1);
        64        // readmulreg(address + 1, ID.serial, 16);
        65        bool serial_read = readmulreg(BNO055_UNIQUE_ID_ADDR, ID.serial, 16);
        66        bool page_restored = setpage(0);
        67        online = serial_read && page_restored;
        68        return online;

## Assistant

`IMU FAILED no uart reply` **не доказывает**, что датчик вообще не прислал байт. На экране так помечается любой сбой `BNO055::check()`: таймаут, неверный ID чипа, ошибка чтения версии или страницы регистров ([проверка в `imu.cpp`](/home/arsenier/Documents/ssl/FootBot4_Firmware/src/devices/imu/imu.cpp:33)). `UART1` при этом могла успешно запуститься на стороне STM32, но связь с IMU этим не подтверждается ([настройка UART1](/home/arsenier/Documents/ssl/FootBot4_Firmware/src/drivers/driver_manager.cpp:39)).

В коде вижу вероятную причину: опрос начинается без паузы после включения датчика. Если ответа нет, сброс тоже пытается пройти по UART и при неудаче ждёт лишь 100 мс; после пяти попыток старт завершается ошибкой. Код сброса сам учитывает ожидание 650 мс после успешной команды сброса. Bosch также указывает время запуска после сброса; задержка до первого опроса — первое, что стоит проверить. [Bosch BNO055 Quick Start](https://www.bosch-sensortec.com/media/boschsensortec/downloads/datasheets/bst-bno055-an007.pdf)

Если пауза не поможет, проверьте:

- Режим UART: `PS1=1`, `PS0=0`; выводы выбора режима не должны плавать.
- Перекрёстное подключение: `PA9/TX → COM1/RX` датчика, `COM0/TX → PA10/RX`; общий GND.
- Параметры UART: `115200`, `8N1`. Это совпадает с конфигурацией прошивки и требованиями Bosch. [Bosch BNO055 UART note](https://www.bosch-sensortec.com/media/boschsensortec/downloads/application_notes_1/bst-bno055-an012.pdf)

**QA:** проверил код и конфигурацию статически. HIL не выполнялся. Анализатор на `PA9/PA10` покажет, где обрывается обмен: прошивка отправляет `AA 01 00 01`, ожидает `BB 01 A0`.

Нужно улучшить экранную диагностику: сейчас надпись `no uart reply` объединяет несколько разных ошибок проверки.

    uint8_t BldcsDriver::init()
    {
        if (!setMonitorSettings())
        {
            kerror("BLDC monitor setup could not be queued on CAN");
        }
    
        kprogress_start("Awaiting BLDC initialization...");
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
        {
            HAL_Delay(100);
            pollFeedback();
            kprogress_tick(25.0);
        }
        if (position_feedback_mask == 0x0F)
        {
            kprogress_finish("BLDC encoder feedback received from all drives");
        }
        else
        {
            kprogress_finish("BLDC feedback incomplete");
            kwarning("BLDC encoder feedback mask: 0x%02X (expected 0x0F)", position_feedback_mask);
        }
    
        setDriveSettings(true);
        return position_feedback_mask;
    }
    
    bool BldcsDriver::setMonitorSettings()
    {
        const uint8_t monitor_registers[4] = {SHAFT_FEEDBACK_R, SUPPLY_VOLTAGE_R, PCB_TEMPERATURE_R,
                                              MOTOR_TEMPERATURE_R};
        return motorWrite(0, MONITOR_SETTINGS_RW, monitor_registers, sizeof(monitor_registers));
    }
    
    void BldcsDriver::broadcastNextSetting(bool is_idle)
    {
        switch (settings_broadcast_step)
        {
            case 0:
                setMonitorSettings();
                break;
            case 1:
                if (!isnan(drive_vel_p))
                {
                    setDriveRegisterFloat(CANFuocoRegisterMap::PID_VELOCITY_P_RW, drive_vel_p);
                }
                break;
            case 2:
                if (!isnan(drive_vel_i))
                {
                    setDriveRegisterFloat(CANFuocoRegisterMap::PID_VELOCITY_I_RW, drive_vel_i);
                }
                break;
            case 3:
                if (!isnan(drive_vel_limit) && !isnan(drive_vel_limit_idle))
                {
                    setDriveRegisterFloat(CANFuocoRegisterMap::PID_VELOCITY_LIMIT_RW,
                                          is_idle ? drive_vel_limit_idle : drive_vel_limit);
                }
                break;
            default:
                settings_broadcast_step = 0;
                return;
        }
    
        settings_broadcast_step = (settings_broadcast_step + 1U) % 4U;
    }
    
    void BldcsDriver::setDriveSettings(bool is_verbose, bool is_idle)
    {
        if (!isnan(drive_vel_p))
        {
            setDriveRegisterFloat(CANFuocoRegisterMap::PID_VELOCITY_P_RW, drive_vel_p);
            if (is_verbose)
            {
                kinfo("Set PID_VELOCITY_P_RW: %f", drive_vel_p);
            }
        }
        if (!isnan(drive_vel_i))
        {
            setDriveRegisterFloat(CANFuocoRegisterMap::PID_VELOCITY_I_RW, drive_vel_i);
            if (is_verbose)
            {
                kinfo("Set PID_VELOCITY_I_RW: %f", drive_vel_i);
            }
        }
        if (!isnan(drive_vel_limit) && !isnan(drive_vel_limit_idle))
        {
            setDriveRegisterFloat(CANFuocoRegisterMap::PID_VELOCITY_LIMIT_RW,
                                  is_idle ? drive_vel_limit_idle : drive_vel_limit);
            if (is_verbose)
            {
                kinfo("Set PID_VELOCITY_LIMIT_RW: %f", drive_vel_limit);
            }
        }
    }
    
    bool BldcsDriver::motorWrite(uint8_t motor_addr, uint8_t register_addr, const uint8_t *data,
                                 uint8_t len)
    {
        uint32_t id = (static_cast<uint32_t>(motor_addr & 0x0F) << 7) | (register_addr & 0x7F);
        return can->write(id, data, len);
    }
    
    void BldcsDriver::setDriveRegisterFloat(uint8_t register_addr, float value)
    {
        motorWrite(0, register_addr, reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(&value), 4);
    }
    
    void BldcsDriver::setDriveVel(BldcsVec vel)
    {
        uint8_t payload[8] = {0};
    
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 4; i++)
        {
            float value = -vel.vec[i];  // Positive speed should be CCW viewed from the top
            ushort value_fp16 = fp32_to_fp16(value);
            reinterpret_cast<uint16_t *>(payload)[i] = value_fp16;
        }
    
        motorWrite(0, MULTI_TARGET_W, payload, 8);
    
        kdebug("setDriveVel: %f %f %f %f", vel.vec[0], vel.vec[1], vel.vec[2], vel.vec[3]);
        target_vel = vel;
    }
    
    void BldcsDriver::pollFeedback()
    {
        uint32_t response_id;
        uint8_t response[8];
        uint8_t response_len;
    
        for (uint8_t frames_read = 0;
             frames_read < 8 && can->read(&response_id, response, &response_len); frames_read++)
        {
            uint8_t motor_addr = (response_id >> 7) & 0x0F;
            uint8_t register_addr = response_id & 0x7F;
            if (motor_addr < 1 || motor_addr > 4)
            {
                continue;
            }
    
            const uint8_t offset = motor_addr - 1;
            if (register_addr == SUPPLY_VOLTAGE_R && response_len == sizeof(float))
            {
                float voltage;
                std::memcpy(&voltage, response, sizeof(voltage));
                can_battery_voltage = voltage;
                can_drive_voltage[offset] = voltage;
                received_feedback_mask |= 1U << offset;
            }
            else if (register_addr == SHAFT_FEEDBACK_R && response_len == 2 * sizeof(float))
            {
                std::memcpy(&current_vel.vec[offset], &response[0], sizeof(float));
                std::memcpy(&current_pos.vec[offset], &response[4], sizeof(float));
                can_drive_velocity[offset] = current_vel.vec[offset];
                can_drive_position[offset] = current_pos.vec[offset];
                received_feedback_mask |= 1U << offset;
                position_feedback_mask |= 1U << offset;
            }
            else if ((register_addr == PCB_TEMPERATURE_R || register_addr == MOTOR_TEMPERATURE_R) &&
                     response_len == sizeof(float))
            {
                float temperature;
                std::memcpy(&temperature, response, sizeof(temperature));
                if (register_addr == PCB_TEMPERATURE_R)
                {
                    can_driver_pcb_temperature[offset] = temperature;
                }
                else
                {
                    can_motor_temperature[offset] = temperature;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    bool BldcsDriver::getFeedback(BldcsVec *velocity, BldcsVec *angle, uint8_t *received_mask)
    {
        if (velocity == nullptr || angle == nullptr || received_mask == nullptr)
        {
            return false;
        }
    
        *velocity = current_vel;
        *angle = current_pos;
        *received_mask = received_feedback_mask;
        return true;
    }
    
    void BldcsDriver::getDriveVel(BldcsVec *vel)
    {
        *vel = current_vel;
        kdebug("getDriveVel: %f %f %f %f", vel->vec[0], vel->vec[1], vel->vec[2], vel->vec[3]);
    }
    
    bool BldcsDriver::getDrivePosition(BldcsVec *position, uint8_t *received_mask)
    {
        if (position == nullptr || received_mask == nullptr)
        {
            return false;
        }
    
        *position = current_pos;
        *received_mask = position_feedback_mask;
        if (*received_mask != 0x0F)
        {
            return false;
        }
    
        position_feedback_mask = 0;
        return true;
    }

    bool CanDriver::write(uint32_t id, const uint8_t *data, uint8_t len)
    {
        if (!initialized_ || data == nullptr || len > 8 || id > 0x7FF)
        {
            return false;
        }
    
        CAN_TxHeaderTypeDef TxHeader;
        uint8_t TxData[8];
        uint32_t TxMailbox;
    
        TxHeader.StdId = id;
        TxHeader.ExtId = 0;
        TxHeader.RTR = CAN_RTR_DATA;
        TxHeader.IDE = CAN_ID_STD;
        TxHeader.DLC = len;
        TxHeader.TransmitGlobalTime = DISABLE;
    
        for (uint8_t i = 0; i < len; i++)
        {
            TxData[i] = data[i];
        }
    
        // Try to add message to available mailbox
        uint32_t timeout = 10000;
        HAL_StatusTypeDef status = HAL_BUSY;
    
        while (status == HAL_BUSY && timeout-- > 0)
        {
            status = HAL_CAN_AddTxMessage(&handle, &TxHeader, TxData, &TxMailbox);
            HAL_Delay(1);
        }
    
        if (status != HAL_OK)
        {
            uint32_t error = HAL_CAN_GetError(&handle);
            kerror("CAN write error: %d, error code: %lu\n", int(status), error);
            return false;
        }
        ++tx_frames_;
        can_monitor_tx_frames = tx_frames_;
        return true;
    }
    
    bool CanDriver::read(uint32_t *id, uint8_t *data, uint8_t *len)
    {
        if (id == nullptr || data == nullptr || len == nullptr)
        {
            return false;
        }
    
        const uint8_t tail = rx_tail_;
        if (tail == rx_head_)
        {
            return false;
        }
    
        __DMB();
        const RxFrame &frame = rx_queue_[tail];
        *id = frame.id;
        *len = frame.len;
        for (uint8_t i = 0; i < frame.len; ++i)
        {
            data[i] = frame.data[i];
        }
    
        __DMB();
        rx_tail_ = (tail + 1) & RX_QUEUE_MASK;
        return true;
    }
    
    bool CanDriver::enqueueFromIsr(const CAN_RxHeaderTypeDef &header, const uint8_t *data)
    {
        if (header.IDE != CAN_ID_STD || header.RTR != CAN_RTR_DATA || header.DLC > 8)
        {
            return false;
        }
    
        const uint8_t head = rx_head_;
        const uint8_t next = (head + 1) & RX_QUEUE_MASK;
        if (next == rx_tail_)
        {
            ++rx_queue_drops_;
            can_monitor_rx_queue_drops = rx_queue_drops_;
            return false;
        }
    
        RxFrame &frame = rx_queue_[head];
        frame.id = header.StdId;
        frame.len = static_cast<uint8_t>(header.DLC);
        for (uint8_t i = 0; i < frame.len; ++i)
        {
            frame.data[i] = data[i];
        }
    
        __DMB();
        rx_head_ = next;
        return true;
    }

## Assistant

Вероятная причина — проверка приводов слишком короткая. При старте прошивка один раз отправляет настройку мониторинга и ждёт обратную связь только **400 мс**. Статус зависит от получения кадров `SHAFT_FEEDBACK_R` от всех четырёх моторов; отдельного подтверждения готовности привода нет ([`bldc.cpp`](/home/arsenier/Documents/ssl/FootBot4_Firmware/src/devices/bldc/bldc.cpp:22)).

Поэтому `CAN OK` не означает, что привода ответили: это лишь успешный запуск CAN в STM32. Если моторы включаются позже или кадры обратной связи не совпали с ожидаемым регистром и длиной, экран покажет ошибку. Статус при этом не обновляется после завершения проверки.

Для точного различения нужны значения с экрана: **CAN**, **DRIVES x/4** и список `MISS IDs`. `CAN FAIL` укажет на запуск CAN; `CAN OK` вместе с `DRIVES 0/4` — на отсутствие ожидаемых кадров обратной связи.

    void CanDriver::recordRxFrame(const CAN_RxHeaderTypeDef &header)
    {
        const uint32_t now = drivers::system_clock::micros();
        const uint32_t frame_bits = 47U + 8U * header.DLC;
        ++rx_frames_;
        rx_bits_estimate_ += frame_bits;
        can_monitor_rx_frames = rx_frames_;
        can_monitor_rx_bits_estimate = rx_bits_estimate_;
        can_monitor_last_rx_id = header.StdId;
        can_monitor_last_rx_dlc = header.DLC;
        if (last_rx_time_us_ != 0)
        {
            last_rx_interval_us_ = now - last_rx_time_us_;
            if (last_rx_interval_us_ > max_rx_interval_us_)
            {
                max_rx_interval_us_ = last_rx_interval_us_;
            }
        }
        last_rx_time_us_ = now;
        can_monitor_rx_interval_us = last_rx_interval_us_;
        can_monitor_rx_interval_max_us = max_rx_interval_us_;
    
        const uint8_t motor_addr = static_cast<uint8_t>((header.StdId >> 7) & 0x0FU);
        const uint8_t register_addr = static_cast<uint8_t>(header.StdId & 0x7FU);
        if (motor_addr >= 1 && motor_addr <= 4 && register_addr >= 102 && register_addr <= 105)
        {
            const uint8_t index = (motor_addr - 1U) * 4U + register_addr - 102U;
            ++monitored_frame_counts_[index];
            if (monitored_frame_last_times_us_[index] != 0)
            {
                monitored_frame_intervals_us_[index] = now - monitored_frame_last_times_us_[index];
            }
            monitored_frame_last_times_us_[index] = now;
            can_monitor_motor_register_frames[index] = monitored_frame_counts_[index];
            can_monitor_motor_register_interval_us[index] = monitored_frame_intervals_us_[index];
        }
    }
    
    void CanDriver::receivePending()
    {
        for (uint8_t frames_read = 0;
             frames_read < RX_FIFO0_DEPTH && HAL_CAN_GetRxFifoFillLevel(&handle, CAN_RX_FIFO0) > 0;
             ++frames_read)
        {
            CAN_RxHeaderTypeDef header;
            uint8_t data[8];
            if (HAL_CAN_GetRxMessage(&handle, CAN_RX_FIFO0, &header, data) != HAL_OK)
            {
                break;
            }
            recordRxFrame(header);
            enqueueFromIsr(header, data);
        }
    }

    void CanDriver::updateMonitorWindow()
    {
        static uint32_t window_start_us = 0;
        static uint32_t window_rx_frames = 0;
        static uint32_t window_tx_frames = 0;
        static uint32_t window_rx_bits = 0;
        const uint32_t now = drivers::system_clock::micros();
        if (window_start_us == 0)
        {
            window_start_us = now;
            window_rx_frames = rx_frames_;
            window_tx_frames = tx_frames_;
            window_rx_bits = rx_bits_estimate_;
            return;
        }
        const uint32_t elapsed_us = now - window_start_us;
        if (elapsed_us < 1000000U)
        {
            return;
        }
        can_monitor_rx_queue_drops = rx_queue_drops_;
        can_monitor_rx_fifo_overruns = rx_fifo_overruns_;
        can_monitor_rx_rate_millihz =
            static_cast<uint32_t>((rx_frames_ - window_rx_frames) * 1000000000ULL / elapsed_us);
        can_monitor_tx_rate_millihz =
            static_cast<uint32_t>((tx_frames_ - window_tx_frames) * 1000000000ULL / elapsed_us);
        can_monitor_bus_load_rx_permille =
            static_cast<uint32_t>((rx_bits_estimate_ - window_rx_bits) * 1000ULL / elapsed_us);
        window_start_us = now;
        window_rx_frames = rx_frames_;
        window_tx_frames = tx_frames_;
        window_rx_bits = rx_bits_estimate_;
    }

## Assistant

На снимке `can_drive_position` и `can_drive_velocity` заполнены для всех четырёх моторов. Значит, прошивка уже принимала от них обратную связь. Эти переменные хранят последние значения: сами по себе они не показывают, продолжают ли моторы передавать кадры.

Нашёл и исправил возможную регрессию: в режиме PLAY планировщик пропускал `setting_broadcaster`, который отправляет настройки мониторинга приводов. Теперь в PLAY работают и экран, и рассылка настроек ([scheduler.cpp](/home/arsenier/Documents/ssl/FootBot4_Firmware/src/kernel/scheduler/scheduler.cpp:103)).

Сборка прошла; на роботе ещё нужно проверить, продолжают ли расти счётчики `can_monitor_motor_register_frames`. HIL-проверка не проводилась.

## User

После перезапуска наблюдается следующая картина через MCUViewer. Через 3-4 секунды после подачи питания с приводов начинает идти обратная связь, при этом корректных приводов на экране нет (0/4). После конца показа экрана обратная связь обновлятся перестает, также как и не обновляется значение угла поворота с IMU

## Assistant

Обе телеметрии прекращаются почти одновременно с переходом экрана. Проверю планировщик, основной цикл и обычную отрисовку: ищу общий блокирующий участок после загрузочного экрана.

## Activity

    $ sed -n '1,180p' src/kernel/scheduler/scheduler.cpp && sed -n '1,180p' src/apps/mainloop/mainloop.cpp && sed -n '130,360p' src/apps/screen/screen.cpp && sed -n '1,120p' src/devices/oled/oled.cpp && rg -n "get_angles|bno055_drv|pollFeedback|update.*imu|pos_global|scheduler::loop|scheduler::init" src/apps src/devices src/main.cpp src/kernel
    #include "scheduler.hpp"
    
    #include "apps/mainloop/mainloop.hpp"
    #include "apps/screen/screen.hpp"
    #include "apps/setting_broadcaster/setting_broadcaster.hpp"
    #include "devices/device_manager.hpp"
    #include "devices/logger/logger.hpp"
    #include "devices/shell/shell.hpp"
    #include "drivers/driver_manager.hpp"
    #include "drivers/system_clock/system_clock.hpp"
    
    namespace kernel::scheduler
    {
    
    static bool is_init = false;
    
    enum Apps
    {
        app_mainloop,
        app_screen,
        app_setting_broadcaster,
        app_shell,
        app_monitor_reset,
        app_count,
    };
    
    #define TPS(x) (static_cast<uint32_t>(1e6 / x))  // Ticks per second
    #define SPT(x) (static_cast<uint32_t>(1e6 * x))  // Seconds per tick
    
    #define ksperiodic [](uint32_t time_elapsed, uint32_t period) { return time_elapsed > period; }
    #define kspersistent [](uint32_t time_elapsed, uint32_t period) { return true; }
    
    void monitor_reset();
    
    TaskDescriptor tasks[app_count] = {
        {"mainloop",
         apps::mainloop::loop,
         0,
         Ts_us,
         //  TPS(5),
         apps::mainloop::is_loop_pending,
         idle,
         {0},
         LOG_INFO},
        {"screen", apps::screen::screen, 0, TPS(10), ksperiodic, idle, {0}, LOG_NONE},
        {"setting_broadcaster",
         apps::setting_broadcaster::broadcast_settings,
         0,
         TPS(2),
         ksperiodic,
         idle,
         {0},
         LOG_NONE},
        {"shell", devices::shell::my_shellLoop, 0, 0, kspersistent, idle, {0}, LOG_DEBUG},
        {"monitor_reset", monitor_reset, 0, TPS(1), ksperiodic, idle, {0}, LOG_DEBUG},
    };
    
    void monitor_reset()
    {
        for (size_t app = 0; app < app_count; app++)
        {
            if (tasks[app].monitor.counter > 100)
            {
                tasks[app].monitor.exec_time = {0};
                tasks[app].monitor.period_time = {0};
                tasks[app].monitor.counter = 0;
            }
        }
    }
    
    static void run(Apps app)
    {
        if (app >= app_count)
        {
            return;
        }
    
        if (tasks[app].state == running)
        {
            return;
        }
        tasks[app].state = running;
        tasks[app].monitor.period_time.update(drivers::system_clock::micros() - tasks[app].last_exec);
        tasks[app].last_exec = drivers::system_clock::micros();
        LogLevel old_log_level = logGetLevel(&devices::logger::uartLog);
        logSetLevel(&devices::logger::uartLog, tasks[app].log_level);
        tasks[app].function();
        logSetLevel(&devices::logger::uartLog, old_log_level);
        tasks[app].monitor.exec_time.update(drivers::system_clock::micros() - tasks[app].last_exec);
        tasks[app].monitor.counter++;
        tasks[app].state = idle;
    }
    
    void yield()
    {
        if (!is_init)
        {
            return;
        }
    
        for (size_t app = 0;
             app < (devices::robot_dev.play_mode == devices::robot::PLAY ? app_shell : app_count);
             app++)
        {
            uint32_t elapsed_time = drivers::system_clock::micros() - tasks[app].last_exec;
            if (tasks[app].is_pending(elapsed_time, tasks[app].period))
            {
                run(static_cast<Apps>(app));
            }
        }
    
        devices::bldcs_drv.pollFeedback();
        drivers::can_drv.updateMonitorWindow();
    }
    
    void init()
    {
        is_init = true;
    
        while (true)
        {
            yield();
        }
    }
    
    void sleep_ms(uint32_t sleep_ms)
    {
        sleep_us(sleep_ms * 1000);
    }
    
    void sleep_us(uint32_t sleep_us)
    {
        uint32_t start = drivers::system_clock::micros();
        while (drivers::system_clock::micros() - start < sleep_us)
        {
            yield();
        }
    }
    
    TaskDescriptor *get_tasks()
    {
        return tasks;
    }
    
    size_t get_task_count()
    {
        return app_count;
    }
    
    }  // namespace kernel::scheduler
    #include "mainloop.hpp"
    
    #include "devices/device_manager.hpp"
    #include "drivers/driver_manager.hpp"
    #include "inttypes.h"
    
    namespace apps::mainloop
    {
    
    constexpr float dribbler_setting_to_vel = 250.0 / 16;
    constexpr float kicker_setting_to_voltage = 200.0 / 16;
    
    bool is_loop_pending(uint32_t time_elapsed, uint32_t period)
    {
        return time_elapsed > period * 0.95;
    }
    
    void loop()
    {
        // Timer
        static uint32_t timer = 0;
        while (drivers::system_clock::micros() - timer < Ts_us)
            ;

        display.rect(114, 25, 13, 7, true);
        display.rectFill(115, 26, bar_width, 5, true);
        display.flush();

    void begin_boot_report(bool is_display_ready)
    {
        display_ready = is_display_ready;
        boot_report_active = true;
        boot_complete = false;
        boot_report_started = drivers::system_clock::micros();
        for (BootStatus &status : boot_status)
        {
            status = {};
        }
        set_boot_status(BootComponent::OLED, display_ready ? BootState::OK : BootState::FAILED);
        current_boot_page = 0;
        render_boot_page(current_boot_page, 0);
    }
    
    void set_boot_status(BootComponent component, BootState state, uint8_t detail)
    {
        if (component >= BootComponent::COUNT)
        {
            return;
        }
        BootStatus &status = boot_status[static_cast<size_t>(component)];
        status.state = state;
        status.detail = detail;
        render_boot_page(current_boot_page, drivers::system_clock::micros() - boot_report_started);
    }
    
    void finish_boot_report()
    {
        boot_complete = true;
        boot_report_started = drivers::system_clock::micros();
        current_boot_page = 0;
        render_boot_page(current_boot_page, 0);
    }
    
    void screen()
    {
        if (!display_ready)
        {
            return;
        }
    
        if (boot_report_active)
        {
            static bool previous_up = false;
            static bool previous_down = false;
            static bool previous_select = false;
            bool up = drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_ADDR_UP].read();
            bool down = drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_ADDR_DOWN].read();
            bool select = drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_SELECT].read();
            bool up_pressed = up && !previous_up;
            bool down_pressed = down && !previous_down;
            bool any_pressed = up_pressed || down_pressed || (select && !previous_select);
    
            previous_up = up;
            previous_down = down;
            previous_select = select;
    
            if (up_pressed)
            {
                current_boot_page = (current_boot_page + 1) % boot_page_count;
            }
            else if (down_pressed)
            {
                current_boot_page = (current_boot_page + boot_page_count - 1) % boot_page_count;
            }
            if (any_pressed)
            {
                boot_report_started = drivers::system_clock::micros();
            }
    
            uint32_t elapsed = drivers::system_clock::micros() - boot_report_started;
            if (elapsed < report_duration_us)
            {
                render_boot_page(current_boot_page, elapsed);
                return;
            }
            boot_report_active = false;
        }
        // static uint32_t last_click = 0;
        // static bool is_updating = true;
    
        static bool was_id_changed = false;
    
        static int counter = 0;
        int version_len = strlen(FIRMWARE_VERSION);
        int version_field_width = 10;
        char vbuf[version_field_width + 1] = {' '};
    
        // https://www.desmos.com/calculator/goy31sxinl
        int t2 = 10;
        int a = version_len > version_field_width ? version_len - version_field_width : 0;
        int t1 = t2 - a;
    
        int A = MIN(MAX(counter - (t1 + a), 0), a);
        int B = MIN(MAX(counter - (t2 + t2 + a), 0), a);
    
        int offset = A - B;
    
        strncpy(vbuf, FIRMWARE_VERSION + offset, version_field_width);
        if (version_len < version_field_width)
        {
            for (size_t i = version_len; i < version_field_width; i++)
            {
                vbuf[i] = ' ';
            }
        }
        vbuf[version_field_width] = '\0';
    
        display.rectFill(0, 0, 126, 32, false);  // Очищаем область
        display.setCursor(0, 0);
        display.setTextSize(1);
        display.printf(
            "robot  %2d%c|%s---------------------x: %6.3f |y: %6.3f\ntheta: %6.3f v: %6.1f",
            devices::robot_dev.robot_id, was_id_changed ? '*' : ' ', vbuf, offset,
            devices::robot_dev.pos_global_current.x, devices::robot_dev.pos_global_current.y,
            devices::robot_dev.pos_global_current.theta, devices::kicker_drv.actual_voltage);
    
        counter++;
        if (counter > a + a + t1 + t2)
        {
            counter = 0;
        }
    
        drivers::out_pins[drivers::LED_DRV1].write(drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_ADDR_UP].read());
        drivers::out_pins[drivers::LED_DRV2].write(drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_ADDR_DOWN].read());
        drivers::out_pins[drivers::LED_DRV3].write(drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_SELECT].read());
        drivers::out_pins[drivers::LED_STM32].toggle();
    
        static bool old_up = false;
        static bool old_down = false;
        static bool old_select = false;
    
        if (drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_ADDR_UP].read())
        {
            was_id_changed = true;
            devices::robot_dev.inc_id();
        }
        if (drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_ADDR_DOWN].read())
        {
            was_id_changed = true;
            devices::robot_dev.dec_id();
        }
    
        static int save_progress = 0;
    
        if (drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_SELECT].read())
        {
            save_progress++;
        }
        else
        {
            save_progress = 0;
        }
    
        if (save_progress != 0)
        {
            display.clear();
            display.setCursor(0, 0);
            display.setTextSize(1);
            display.printf("    Hold to save    \n settings to EEPROM \n");
            display.printf("     [");
            for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++)
            {
                display.printf("%c", i <= save_progress ? '#' : ' ');
            }
            display.printf("]");
        }
    
        if (save_progress > 10)
        {
            kinfo("Saving robot config to EEPROM");
            display.clear();

    void Robot::init(RobotSettings &settings)
    {
        static_cast<RobotSettings &>(*this) = settings;
    
        sense();
        pos_global_target.theta = pos_global_current.theta;
        vel_local_output_smoothed = {0, 0, 0};
    }
    
    void Robot::sense()
    {
        chassis_drv.getVel(&vel_global_current);
        devices::chassis::StateVector local_position_delta{};
        bool has_position_delta = chassis_drv.getPositionDelta(&local_position_delta);
    
        float heading = odom_dev.state.theta;
        imu_heading_valid = bno055_drv.get_angles();
        if (imu_heading_valid)
        {
            heading = -bno055_drv.euler.yaw;
        }
        if (has_position_delta)
        {
            odom_dev.updateLocalDelta(local_position_delta, heading);
        }
        else
        {
            odom_dev.state.theta = heading;
            odom_dev.thetaAntiWindup();
        }
    
        odom_dev.getState(&pos_global_current);
        // kicker_drv.get_voltage();
    }

    uint8_t calculate_signature(RobotSettings config)
    {
        uint8_t signature = 0;
        uint8_t *data = reinterpret_cast<uint8_t *>(&config);
    
        for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(RobotSettings) - 2; i++)
        {
            signature ^= data[i];
        }
    
        return signature;
    }

        float vel_abs =

        if (vel_abs > max_linear_vel)
        {
            vel_local_output.x = vel_local_output.x / vel_abs * max_linear_vel;
            vel_local_output.y = vel_local_output.y / vel_abs * max_linear_vel;

    }

    bool BNO055::get_angles(void)
    {
        if (!online)
        {
            return false;
        }
        tx[0] = BNO055_EULER_H_LSB_ADDR;
        // _i2c.write(address, tx, 1, true);
        // _i2c.read(address + 1, rawdata, 6, 0);
        if (!readmulreg(BNO055_EULER_H_LSB_ADDR, rawdata, 6))
        {
            online = false;
            return false;
        }
        euler.rawyaw = (static_cast<uint8_t>(rawdata[1]) << 8 | static_cast<uint8_t>(rawdata[0]));
        euler.rawroll = (static_cast<uint8_t>(rawdata[3]) << 8 | static_cast<uint8_t>(rawdata[2]));
        euler.rawpitch = (static_cast<uint8_t>(rawdata[5]) << 8 | static_cast<uint8_t>(rawdata[4]));
        euler.yaw = float(euler.rawyaw) * angle_scale + 1.57;
        // Flipped roll and pitch to offset screwy work by others
        euler.roll = float(euler.rawpitch) * angle_scale * (-1.0);
        euler.pitch = float(euler.rawroll) * angle_scale;
        return true;
    }

        void writemulreg(char reg_addr, char *buff, size_t buff_size)
        {
            tx[0] = 0xAA;  // Start byte
            tx[1] = 0x00;  // Write
            tx[2] = reg_addr;
            tx[3] = buff_size;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < buff_size; i++)
            {
                tx[i + 4] = buff[i];
            }
            uart_drv.write(tx, buff_size + 4);
    
            char rx_buff[2] = {};
            HAL_StatusTypeDef status = uart_drv.read(rx_buff, sizeof(rx_buff), 10000U);
            if (status != HAL_OK || static_cast<uint8_t>(rx_buff[0]) != 0xEE ||
                static_cast<uint8_t>(rx_buff[1]) != 0x01)
            {
                kerror("BNO055 UART block write failed: reg=0x%02X status=%d ack=%02X %02X",
                       static_cast<uint8_t>(reg_addr), static_cast<int>(status),
                       static_cast<uint8_t>(rx_buff[0]), static_cast<uint8_t>(rx_buff[1]));
                return;
            }
        }
    
        bool setpage(char value)
        {
            return writecharreg(BNO055_PAGE_ID_ADDR, value);
        }

    // Convert unsigned 8-bit to signed 8-bit
    int8_t Nrf24Recv::u8Toi8(uint8_t x)
    {
        if (x & 0x80)
            return -static_cast<int8_t>(0x100 - x);
        return static_cast<int8_t>(x);
    }
    
    void Nrf24Recv::recv_irq()
    {
        uint8_t reg = 1;
        uint32_t time_ms = 0;       // HAL_GetTick();
        int rc = readReg(7, &reg);  // 7 = NRF24_REG_FIFO_STATUS
        if (rc < 0)
        {
            // Error handling - could add logging here
        }
    
        if (!(reg & 0x40))  // RX_DR - Data Not Ready
        {
            return;
        }
    
        dts_led.toggle();
    
        uint32_t timeout_nrf_timer_recv = 0;            // HAL_GetTick();
        rc = spi_instance.rawRead(0x60, &m_lenDbg, 1);  // 0x60 = R_RX_PL_WID command
        if (rc < 0)
        {
            // Error handling
        }
    
        if (m_lenDbg < 6)
        {
            // Log error - could add logging here
        }
    
        if (m_lenDbg == 0 || m_lenDbg > m_incomePacketLen)
        {
            writeReg(0x07, 0x40);  // Clear RX_DR interrupt
            spi_instance.flushRx();
            return;
        }
    
        if (time_ms - m_prevTime_ms > 1000)
        {
            m_prevTime_ms = time_ms;
            m_packetsReceived_1s = m_packetsReceived;
            m_packetsReceived = 0;
            m_ownPacketsReceived_1s = m_ownPacketsReceived;
            m_ownPacketsReceived = 0;
        }
        m_packetsReceived++;
    
        spi_instance.rawRead(0x61, m_incomeArray, m_lenDbg);
    
        writeReg(0x07, 0x40);  // Clear RX_DR interrupt
    
        m_lastPacketTime = HAL_GetTick();
    
        // nrfm_decoder.nrfm_rx_callback(m_incomeArray, m_lenDbg);
    
        spi_instance.flushRx();
    
        Nrf24Packet packet = {{}, m_lenDbg};
    
        for (size_t i = 0; i < m_lenDbg; i++)
        {
            packet.data[i] = m_incomeArray[i];
        }
    
        m_rx_queue.push_back(packet);
    }
    
    // Main receive function
    int Nrf24Recv::fetch()
    {
        while (!m_rx_queue.isEmpty())
        {
            Nrf24Packet packet = m_rx_queue.pop_front();
    
            nrfm_decoder.nrfm_rx_callback(packet.data, packet.len);
        }
    
        // spi_instance.flushRx();
    
        // HAL_Delay(1);
        return 0;
    }

    }
    
    // Constructor
    bool Nrf24Recv::init()
    {
        // spi.init()
    
        // Set CE high to enable the module
        spi_instance.setCe();
        for (int i = 0; i < 5000; i++)
            ;
        // HAL_Delay(5);
        spi_instance.resetCe();
    
        // Initialize NRF24 module
        auto w = [this](uint8_t reg, uint8_t val) { writeReg(reg, val); };
        auto r = [this](uint8_t reg)
        {
            uint8_t data = 2;
            readReg(reg, &data);
            return data;
        };
    
        // Configure NRF24
        w(0x00, 0x0E);  // CONFIG: PWR_UP, CRCO=1 (2-byte CRC)
        uint8_t a = r(0x00);
        if (a != 0x0E)
        {
            // Error - NRF24 not responding
            return true;
        }
    
        w(0x00, 0x0C);  // CONFIG: PWR_UP, CRCEN, PRIM_RX=0 (TX mode)
        w(0x06, 0x06);  // RF_SETUP: 250kbps, 0dBm
        w(0x02, 0x00);  // EN_RXADDR: All pipes disabled
        w(0x1C, 0x3F);  // DYNPD: Enable dynamic payload
        w(0x01, 0x3F);  // EN_AA: Enable auto-ack on all pipes
        w(0x1D, 0x05);  // FEATURE: Enable features
        w(0x04, 0x53);  // SETUP_RETR: 5 retransmit, 500us delay
    
        uint8_t default_addr_0[]{0xe7, 0xe7, 0xe7, 0xe7, 0xe7};
        spi_instance.rawWrite(0x0A, default_addr_0, 5);
    
        w(NRF24_REG_RX_PW_P0, 0x00);
    
        uint8_t default_addr_1[]{0xc2, 0xc2, 0xc2, 0xc2, 0xc2};
        spi_instance.rawWrite(0x0B, default_addr_1, 5);
    
        w(NRF24_REG_RX_PW_P1, 0x00);
        w(NRF24_REG_RX_ADDR_P2, 0xC3);
        w(NRF24_REG_RX_PW_P2, 0x00);
        w(NRF24_REG_RX_ADDR_P3, 0xC4);
        w(NRF24_REG_RX_PW_P3, 0x00);
        w(NRF24_REG_RX_ADDR_P4, 0xC5);
        w(NRF24_REG_RX_PW_P4, 0x00);
        w(NRF24_REG_RX_ADDR_P5, 0xC6);
        w(NRF24_REG_RX_PW_P5, 0x00);
    
        spi_instance.rawWrite(0x10, default_addr_0, 5);
    
        w(0x03, 0x03);
        if (devices::robot_dev.robot_id <= 7)
        {
            w(0x05, 111);  // channel set
        }
        else
        {
            w(0x05, 0x43);  // channel set
        }
        {
            kerror("Square test blocked: IMU heading unavailable");
            return;
        }
    
        square_side = 0;
        square_running = true;
        linear_mode = VELOCITY_GLOBAL;
        angle_mode = ANGLEPOS;
        square_heading = pos_global_current.theta;
        pos_global_target.theta = square_heading;
        square_start = pos_global_current;
        square_turning = false;
        vel_global_target = {0.35f * cos(square_heading), 0.35f * sin(square_heading), 0.0f};
        update_nonidle_timer();
        kinfo("Square test started: side=0.25m, sides=4");
    }
    
    void Robot::update_square_test()
    {
        if (!square_running)
        {
            return;
        }
    
        if (!imu_heading_valid)
        {
            vel_global_target = {0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
            square_running = false;
            play_mode = PLAY;
            kerror("Square test stopped: IMU heading lost");
            return;
        }
    
        if (square_turning)
        {
            float angle_error = pos_global_target.theta - pos_global_current.theta;
            while (angle_error > M_PI)
            {
                angle_error -= 2.0f * M_PI;
            }
            while (angle_error < -M_PI)
            {
                angle_error += 2.0f * M_PI;
            }
            if (fabs(angle_error) > 0.05f)
            {
                return;
            }
    
            square_turning = false;
            square_start = pos_global_current;
            vel_global_target = {0.35f * cos(square_heading), 0.35f * sin(square_heading), 0.0f};
            return;
        }
    
        float dx = pos_global_current.x - square_start.x;
        float dy = pos_global_current.y - square_start.y;
        float distance = dx * cos(square_heading) + dy * sin(square_heading);
        if (distance < 0.25f)
        {
            return;
        }
    
        square_side++;
        vel_global_target = {0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
        if (square_side >= 4)
        {
            square_running = false;
            play_mode = PLAY;
            kinfo("Square test complete");
            return;
        }
    
        square_turning = true;
        square_heading += static_cast<float>(M_PI) / 2.0f;
        pos_global_target.theta = square_heading;
        kinfo("Square test: side %u/4 complete", square_side);
    }
    
    void Robot::plan()
    {
        if (linear_mode == VELOCITY_GLOBAL)
        {
            vel_local_output.x = vel_global_target.x;
            vel_local_output.y = vel_global_target.y;
    
            vel_local_output = odom_dev.rotate(vel_local_output, -pos_global_current.theta);
        }
        else if (linear_mode == VELOCITY_LOCAL)
        {
            vel_local_output.x = vel_global_target.x;
            vel_local_output.y = vel_global_target.y;
        }
        else if (linear_mode == COORDINATE)
        {
            // TODO position control
        }
    
        if (angle_mode == ANGLEVEL)
        {
            // Just keep current target_vel
            vel_local_output.theta = vel_global_target.theta;
            // pos_global_target.theta = pos_global_target.theta
    
            // if (pos_global_target.theta - pos_global_current.theta > M_PI * 0.8)
            // {
            //     pos_global_target.theta = pos_global_current.theta + M_PI * 0.8;
            // }
            // else if (pos_global_target.theta - pos_global_current.theta < -M_PI * 0.8)
            // {
            //     pos_global_target.theta = pos_global_current.theta - M_PI * 0.8;
            // }
        }
        else if (angle_mode == ANGLEPOS)
        {
            float error = pos_global_target.theta - pos_global_current.theta;
            while (error > M_PI)
            {
                error -= 2 * M_PI;
            }
            while (error < -M_PI)
            {
                error += 2 * M_PI;
            }
            vel_local_output.theta = error * (angle_b + sqrt(vel_local_output.x * vel_local_output.x +
                                                             vel_local_output.y * vel_local_output.y) *

        }
    
        // kicker_drv.set_target(100);

        {
            if (play_mode == PLAY)

            }
        }
        if (play_mode == TEST)
        {
            update_square_test();
            if (!square_running)
            {
                play_mode = PLAY;
            }
        }

    void Robot::act()
    {
        float vel_abs =
            sqrt(vel_local_output.x * vel_local_output.x + vel_local_output.y * vel_local_output.y);
        if (vel_abs > max_linear_vel)
        {
            vel_local_output.x = vel_local_output.x / vel_abs * max_linear_vel;
            vel_local_output.y = vel_local_output.y / vel_abs * max_linear_vel;
        }
    
        if (fabs(vel_local_output.theta) > max_angular_vel)
        {
            vel_local_output.theta =
                vel_local_output.theta / fabs(vel_local_output.theta) * max_angular_vel;
        }
    
        vel_local_output_smoothed.x +=
            MIN(MAX((vel_local_output.x - vel_local_output_smoothed.x) / Ts_s, -max_linear_accel),
                max_linear_accel) *
            Ts_s;
        vel_local_output_smoothed.y +=
            MIN(MAX((vel_local_output.y - vel_local_output_smoothed.y) / Ts_s, -max_linear_accel),
                max_linear_accel) *
            Ts_s;
        vel_local_output_smoothed.theta +=
            MIN(MAX((vel_local_output.theta - vel_local_output_smoothed.theta) / Ts_s,
                    -max_angular_accel),
                max_angular_accel) *
            Ts_s;
    
        chassis_drv.setVel(vel_local_output_smoothed);
    
        is_idle = drivers::system_clock::micros() - nonidle_timer > 10000000;
    
        if (dribbler_update)
        {
            bldcs_drv.setDribblerVel(dribbler_setting * dribbler_setting_to_vel);
            dribbler_update = false;
        }
    
        kicker_drv.update();
    
        if (!drivers::in_pins[drivers::BUTTON_TURN_OFF].read())
        {
            drivers::bootstrap_drv.turn_off();
        }
    }

        /**
         * @brief Отправить данные по I2C
         * @param addr7 7-битный адрес устройства
         * @param data Указатель на данные
         * @param len Длина данных
         * @return true при успехе
         */
        bool write(uint8_t addr7, const uint8_t* data, size_t len) override
        {
            if (!hi2c_ || !data || len == 0)
            {
                return false;
            }
    
            // HAL требует 8-битный адрес (7-бит << 1)
            uint16_t addr8 = static_cast<uint16_t>(addr7) << 1;
    
            HAL_StatusTypeDef status = HAL_I2C_Master_Transmit(
                hi2c_, addr8, const_cast<uint8_t*>(data), static_cast<uint16_t>(len), timeout_);
    
            return (status == HAL_OK);
        }
    
        /**
         * @brief Проверить наличие устройства на шине
         * @param addr7 7-битный адрес устройства
         * @return true если устройство отвечает (ACK)
         */
        bool probe(uint8_t addr7) override
        {
            if (!hi2c_)
                return false;
    
            uint16_t addr8 = static_cast<uint16_t>(addr7) << 1;
    
            // HAL_I2C_IsDeviceReady проверяет наличие устройства
            HAL_StatusTypeDef status = HAL_I2C_IsDeviceReady(hi2c_, addr8,
                                                             1,  // Trials
                                                             timeout_);
    
            return (status == HAL_OK);
        }
    
      private:
        I2C_HandleTypeDef* hi2c_;
        uint32_t timeout_;
    };
    
    }  // namespace oled_lib
    
    #endif  // OLED_USE_STM32HAL

    void Gfx::drawChar(int x, int y, char c, bool color, uint8_t scale)
    {
        // Проверка диапазона символа
        if (c < FONT_FIRST_CHAR || c > FONT_LAST_CHAR)
        {
            c = ' ';  // Заменяем неизвестные символы пробелом
        }
    
        // Индекс в таблице шрифта
        size_t charIdx = static_cast<size_t>(c - FONT_FIRST_CHAR) * FONT_WIDTH;
    
        // Рисуем каждую колонку символа
        for (uint8_t col = 0; col < FONT_WIDTH; ++col)
        {
            uint8_t colData = FONT_5X7[charIdx + col];
    
            // Рисуем каждый бит (строку)
            for (uint8_t row = 0; row < FONT_HEIGHT; ++row)
            {
                bool pixelOn = (colData >> row) & 0x01;
    
                // Если пиксель включён (или инверсия для фона)
                if (pixelOn)
                {
                    // С учётом масштаба
                    for (uint8_t sy = 0; sy < scale; ++sy)
                    {
                        for (uint8_t sx = 0; sx < scale; ++sx)
                        {
                            pixel(x + col * scale + sx, y + row * scale + sy, color);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    int Gfx::decodeUtf8(const char* str, uint16_t& codepoint)
    {
        if (!str || !*str)
        {
            codepoint = 0;
            return 0;
        }
    
        uint8_t b0 = static_cast<uint8_t>(str[0]);
    
        // ASCII (0xxxxxxx)
        if ((b0 & 0x80) == 0)
        {
            codepoint = b0;
            return 1;
        }
    
        // 2-байтовая последовательность (110xxxxx 10xxxxxx)
        if ((b0 & 0xE0) == 0xC0)
        {
            if (!str[1])
                return 0;
            uint8_t b1 = static_cast<uint8_t>(str[1]);
            if ((b1 & 0xC0) != 0x80)
                return 0;
    
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    void Gfx::print(const char* str)
    {
        if (!str)
            return;
    
        while (*str)
        {
            uint16_t codepoint;
            int len = decodeUtf8(str, codepoint);
    
            if (len == 0)
            {
                // Ошибка декодирования - пропускаем байт
                str++;
                continue;
            }
    
            str += len;
    
            // Перенос строки
            if (codepoint == '\n')
            {
                cursorX_ = 0;
                cursorY_ += (FONT_HEIGHT + 1) * textScale_;
                continue;
            }
    
            // Возврат каретки
            if (codepoint == '\r')
            {
                cursorX_ = 0;
                continue;
            }
    
            // Рисуем символ
            drawGlyph(cursorX_, cursorY_, codepoint, textColor_, textScale_);
    
            // Сдвигаем курсор (ширина символа + 1 пиксель межбуквенный интервал)
            cursorX_ += (FONT_WIDTH + 1) * textScale_;
    #define OLED_PRINTF_BUFFER_SIZE 128

    namespace devices::shell
    {
    
    Shell shell;
    
    signed short shellWrite(char *data, unsigned short len)
    {
        for (unsigned short i = 0; i < len; i++)
        {
            kernel::scheduler::yield();
            drivers::uart4.putc(data[i]);
        }
        drivers::uart4.flush_tx();
        return len;
    }
    
    signed short shellRead(char *data, unsigned short len)
    {
        unsigned short recv = len;
        for (unsigned short i = 0; i < len; i++)
        {
            kernel::scheduler::yield();
            if (drivers::uart4.getc(&data[i]) != HAL_OK)
            {
                recv = i;
                break;
            }
        }
        return recv;
    }
    
    char shellBuffer[512];
    
    void my_shellInit()
    {
        shell.read = shellRead;
        shell.write = shellWrite;
        shellInit(&shell, shellBuffer, 512);
    }
    
    void my_shellLoop()
    {
        shellTask(&shell);
    }

## Assistant

`DRIVES 0/4` — устаревший результат стартовой проверки: она ждёт обратную связь всего 400 мс, а кадры, по вашему наблюдению, начинаются через 3–4 секунды. Поздние ответы этот экранный статус не обновляют.

Окончание экрана само по себе не отключает опрос IMU или CAN. В коде `pollFeedback()` продолжает вызываться планировщиком. Значение угла при неподвижном роботе может оставаться неизменным, даже если IMU опрашивается.

Чтобы понять, где прекращается поток, постройте графики `can_monitor_rx_frames`, `can_monitor_rx_rate_millihz` и `can_monitor_motor_register_frames[0..15]`. Счётчики обновляются в CAN-прерывании. Если они продолжают расти, а `can_drive_*` замирают, проблема в разборе очереди; если останавливаются тоже — прекратились CAN-кадры. Для IMU добавьте к графику `robot_dev.imu_heading_valid`: один лишь неизменный угол не показывает, поступают ли новые измерения.

## Activity

    $ python3 - <<'PY'
        import json, re, subprocess
        from pathlib import Path
        project = Path('FootBot4_Firmware_disco_f429zi.mcuv')
        elf = Path('.pio/build/disco_f429zi/firmware.elf')
        data = json.loads(project.read_text())
        nm = '/home/arsenier/.platformio/packages/toolchain-gccarmnoneeabi/bin/arm-none-eabi-nm'
        lines = subprocess.check_output([nm, '-S', '-n', str(elf)], text=True).splitlines()
        symbols = {}
        for line in lines:
            fields = line.split()
            if len(fields) == 4:
                symbols[fields[3]] = (int(fields[0], 16), int(fields[1], 16))
        errors = []
        for var in data['variables']:
            name, addr, typ = var['name'], int(var['address'], 16), var['type']
            match = re.fullmatch(r'([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\[(\d+)\]', name)
            if match:
                base, index = match.group(1), int(match.group(2))
                expected = symbols[base][0] + index * 4
            elif name == 'devices::robot_dev.imu_heading_valid':
                expected = 0x2000D225
            else:
                expected = symbols[name][0]
            if addr != expected:
                errors.append((name, hex(addr), hex(expected)))
        known = {v['name'] for v in data['variables']}
        missing = sorted({s['variable'] for g in data['groups'] for p in g['plots'] for s in p.get('series', [])} - known)
        print(f"variables={len(data['variables'])} groups={len(data['groups'])} bad_addresses={len(errors)} missing_plot_refs={len(missing)}")
        if errors: print('bad:', errors)
        if missing: print('missing:', missing)
        PY

## Assistant

Трасса показывает две отдельные проблемы:

- **Привода:** CAN-кадры пошли на 3,98 с и прекратились на 5,75 с. Все четыре мотора успели передать shaft feedback: счётчики `[87, 89, 89, 42]`. Переполнений RX FIFO и очереди нет.
- **IMU:** `imu_heading_valid` стал `1` на 0,52 с, затем упал в `0` на 0,62 с — раньше конца экрана. Один сбой чтения в `get_angles()` навсегда переводит BNO055 в `offline`; повторной проверки нет ([imu.cpp](/home/arsenier/Documents/ssl/FootBot4_Firmware/src/devices/imu/imu.cpp:321)).

В CAN-драйвере убрал ожидание свободного mailbox до 10 секунд: при заполнении новый кадр теперь пропускается, цикл не блокируется ([can.cpp](/home/arsenier/Documents/ssl/FootBot4_Firmware/src/drivers/can/can.cpp:150)). Это могло останавливать основной цикл и обновления. Сборка прошла; на плату прошивку не загружал. Причину прекращения кадров на шине эта правка сама по себе не подтверждает.

## Assistant

Трасса: `imu_heading_valid` держится `1` до ~4,6 с, затем падает. Все четыре привода передают shaft feedback; счётчики доходят до `[86, 88, 88, 42]`. Около 5,85 с RX/TX и обратная связь почти замирают. Переполнений RX FIFO и очереди нет.

Внёс две правки:

- IMU повторяет чтение через 500 мс после временного сбоя UART вместо постоянного перехода в offline.
- CAN считает попытки записи при занятых mailbox; счётчик добавлен в график `CAN FIFO/queue/TX busy` для следующего захвата.

Сборка прошла. `.mcuv` проверен: 67 адресов совпадают с ELF, ссылки графиков целостны. На плате новые изменения ещё не проверялись.
